treasures.name: Connection Detector
treasures.description: This enigmatic object seems designed to connect to something. Or maybe to make a connection between two things. But what does it connect to, or whom does it connect? Well, we can all agree that everything is better with connection than without.

treasures.name: Creativity Conduit
treasures.description: Can you feel it? The creative energy that flows through this object is undeniable! The color, the curvature, the smoothness to the touch... They light up the right side of the brain— the side that governs the arts. Infinite imagined possibilities await!

treasures.name: Dream Architect
treasures.description: Going to bed early is a waste of time for a lively soul. This dream-maker makes night fun! ...Fine, so it is broken and does not work. That is a drawback. Come on! Use your imagination!

treasures.name: Glee Spinner
treasures.description: This produces a mysterious, shape-induced mental effect in all living creatures. You simply MUST rotate it! Spin, spin, spin, spin... What fun it must be!

treasures.name: Life Controller
treasures.description: The cross-shaped structure on this device is not only satisfying to press up, down, and side to side but also clearly moves something. Strange to say, but I almost feel as though it's controlling...me. But WHO would be controlling me? I must know who it is!

treasures.name: Micromanagement Station
treasures.description: This desk features a built-in display surely used to show important things such as maps and vital statistics. No doubt many heated discussions have taken place over the matters shown here. One hopes that those who worked and fought at this desk also took breaks for rest and frivolity.

treasures.name: Stone of Advancement
treasures.description: Notice how resplendent the blue of this slab is! It's called "cobalt blue." The pigment is extracted from an ore renowned for honing one's intuition, intelligence, and reflexes. Yes, the more I gaze upon it, the more advanced I feel myself become.

treasures.name: Stone of Glory
treasures.description: This odd rock is completely filled with nostalgia. None can dispute the magical powers of this stone. Can the day when this rock rules the entire universe be far away?

treasures.name: Telekinesis Detector
treasures.description: Do you believe in psychic powers? You will once you observe this device's uncanny behavior. That is, it vibrates all on its own! Surely this is proof that telekinesis—or yes, even psychokinesis—exist. Gaaah! Did it just vibrate again?!

treasures.name: Winged Freedom Sculpture
treasures.description: Beauty soars to new heights here. This magnificent sculpture captures the form of a white bird gliding through air. But what does it MEAN? I say this isn't just about a bird. This is about freedom. Just look at it— it IS freedom itself!

treasures.name: Aspiration-Ritual Ball
treasures.description: These balls were an integral part of a ritual performed during New Year festivals. Each ball was imbued with people's hopes and dreams, and if caught by the ritual pole, those hopes and dreams were bound to come true. What a joy it must've been to witness such a beautiful tradition.

treasures.name: Aspiration-Ritual Pole
treasures.description: This ritual pole was used during an ancient festival held at the start of each new year. If the ball landed on the sharp end, the people's wishes would come true and they would dance in celebration. Though it's commonly believed the people danced either way.

treasures.name: Chance Totem
treasures.description: More powerful than effort, more relentless than talent, LUCK is the true ruler of life. This mystical stone tests the path of luck. So, are you the true master of your life?

treasures.name: Cosmic Archive
treasures.description: All worldly matters, from time's start to its end, are said to be recorded in this historical vault! It is so huge, decoding it all is impossible. Its mere existence is said to make one philosophical.

treasures.name: Difficult-Choice Totem
treasures.description: This tool can be helpful when one finds oneself faced with an especially hard choice. Simply roll this stone and leave the decision to fate. But when the roll ends abruptly, will you like the decision fate picked for you...or will you wish you decided for yourself?

treasures.name: Glinty Circular Disc
treasures.description: This disc vexes me greatly. I've analyzed it, meditated over it, and even given it a good whack or two, and still I can't decipher its purpose! But drawing upon my rather prodigious treasure knowledge, I surmise it is either a piece of equipment used for gathering solar energy, or it's a weapon capable of reflecting light at troublesome beasts to scare them off. Quite useful either way!

treasures.name: Go-with-the-Flow Totem
treasures.description: With this many sides, how is this totem not just a sphere? Give it a roll, and it seems like it might never stop. And when it does...well, there are so very many numbers it could land on. Does it really matter which one? Best to just go with the flow.

treasures.name: Long-Shot Totem
treasures.description: Rolling this stone so that it lands on the specific symbol you want is no easy task. Twelve sides is a lot of sides! Why even try? But when you do at last get the symbol you hoped for—what a thrill! It's sure to keep you trying again and again.

treasures.name: Masterpiece Plank
treasures.description: This yellow plank... Simply marvelous! The text upon it is indecipherable yet somehow moving. Could it be some sort of a story? A masterpiece, I'm sure of it! How exasperating it is not to be able to read it even as it sits right here before me.

treasures.name: Priceless Statue
treasures.description: This stone carving was lined up with others as if they were meant to protect something. Proof of a megalithic civilization! (I am unsure about that, but bluffing is paramount.)

treasures.name: Spinning Memories Plank
treasures.description: Spinning, spinning, spinning...These memories are spinning in my head... Or are they memories of spinning itself? Wait...what is happening?! I'm starting to believe this mysterious black plank actually contains someone else's memories. Dizzyingly strange!

treasures.name: Strife Monolith
treasures.description: The world is divided into two groups: ones and zeros. Are you in the winning or losing group? If you love the thrill of the game, but do not care for the outcome, then this stone is for you! It symbolizes both victory and defeat. What a concept.

treasures.name: Talisman of Life
treasures.description: At the end of a long life, some beings wish to leave the world and stroll in a field of flowers. Does this desire ever come to fruition? I do not know... but this beautiful deck of luck wafers makes me wonder. Even we machines ponder the great power-down at the end of the trail.

treasures.name: Talisman of Life (Cherry Blossom)
treasures.description: Starting school, getting a new job... People in ancient times prayed to this luck wafer at moments of big change in their lives. Flowers do bring to mind new beginnings, so it makes sense. We all want to blossom, don't we?

treasures.name: Talisman of Life (Crane)
treasures.description: The citizens of this planet once wished upon this luck wafer for a long life. You see, the strange bird pictured there is said to live a very long life. Additionally, the bird seems to be facing a supernova—the final stage of a star's existence. Ah, to live for billions of years like star does... One can hardly even imagine it!

treasures.name: Talisman of Life (Moon)
treasures.description: The ancient people of this planet used this luck wafer during wedding ceremonies. They did so because the moon is the object one stares at when one thinks about someone they love. Or at least, that's what I stare at when I have love on my mind. Alas, at this very moment, I have no one to think about.

treasures.name: Talisman of Life (Phoenix)
treasures.description: I've heard a story about a company that was in decline. But when they hung this wafer above the entry door, their performance shot up from the ashes like a phoenix. Hmm...maybe if I hang this picture, it will light a fire under my appraisal business.

treasures.name: Talisman of Life (Rain)
treasures.description: The ancient people turned to this luck wafer when things weren't going well for them. It served as a reminder that no matter how much it rained, the storm always eventually passed. And the same goes for bad times. These, too, always blow away on the breeze.

treasures.name: Worthless Statue
treasures.description: Once, on an unknown planet, a megalithic civilization flourished, and this is proof of its existence! For hoarders of ancient artifacts, this is a must-have piece! Truly, collectors will crave it! (I do not know if that is true or not, but items in demand fetch higher prices.)

treasures.name: Abstract Masterpiece
treasures.description: This is something that machines cannot comprehend... The heart of art, the soul of creativity. If you understand the appeal of this design, your heightened senses are at space-pilot level!

treasures.name: Activity Arouser
treasures.description: This esoteric design will make viewers want to get up and move for no apparent reason. This is perfect for people who want to diet but can never seem to get started.

treasures.name: Alien Billboard
treasures.description: Perhaps this is some ancient billboard...but perhaps not. Its authenticity may be in question, but if you can use it for inspiration, you may become a topflight ad executive.

treasures.name: Ambiguous Hostel
treasures.description: It seems that something—or more likely some things—lived within the inner cavity of this device. What were these things? What was their purpose? Were they forced to live there together as part of an experiment? Some things are destined to remain unknown.

treasures.name: Arboreal Frippery
treasures.description: Perfect for those who love natural designs in their home, this leaf applique is a bargain! Use it in pieces, or cover an entire wall in leafiness!

treasures.name: Armored Nut
treasures.description: This common, ordinary nut somehow reminds me of myself and fills me with sadness.

treasures.name: Birdy Bed
treasures.description: Birds have long been a symbol of freedom and good luck. In fact, if one appears in your dreams at night, then good fortune is sure to visit you during the day. With that in mind, sleep on this bed, and you're almost guaranteed to find birds flocking to your dreams.

treasures.name: Blast Shield
treasures.description: Even the blast from a rocket leaving a planet can't penetrate this shield. Its protective powers are so robust that after years of use by a battle-worn soldier, there's but one small scratch on the surface. A fine piece of vintage armor, to be sure.

treasures.name: Broken Food Master
treasures.description: Behold the heavenly sparkle of this, one of the three sacred treasures of Samadush! Now you can own the artifact of endless food and drink! Of course...to a tongueless machine such as me, this is all completely meaningless.

treasures.name: Colossal Fossil
treasures.description: A colossal fossil for collectors of bone. Bones this big make bone houses seem not so crazy!

treasures.name: Faux Fishy
treasures.description: A sacred fish created to amuse and comfort the ancient gods. They would submerge the fish in a heavenly spring and while the hours away pretending to catch and feed it. It would seem the gods had blessed themselves with way too much free time.

treasures.name: Fortified Delicacy
treasures.description: A twisted shell whose surface is covered in spikes. The durable housing protects a meal that is said to define deliciousness. (Where the meal went is known only to Captain Olimar's crew.)

treasures.name: Good Old Memories
treasures.description: The milky scent is reminiscent of nostalgic days. The times when being spoiled for no reason was allowed. Those happy memories are the very things that forms your current self.

treasures.name: Indomitable CPU
treasures.description: This will solve any problem, given enough time! This CPU's true processing grit sells itself.

treasures.name: Mirrored Stage
treasures.description: Come rain, wind, or typhoon, this stage will always support the hidden singer deep in your soul. It is a lovely instant dance stage. How about taking one on tour with you, star of rock?

treasures.name: Newtolite Shell
treasures.description: This is the fossil of an ancient sea creature. Sure, it looks like nothing but a brown blob from above, but flip it over, and...SURPRISE! It sparkles like a gem lit from the inside! The iridescent pattern reminds of a water-dwelling newt found on my home planet.

treasures.name: Remembered Old Buddy
treasures.description: This relic rose directly from the sands of time! Its shape invokes waves of sweet nostalgia. Middle-aged men throughout the universe harken back to their youth and grin... They pass on their tales to the next generation, filling them with adventure and romance!

treasures.name: Seed of Greed
treasures.description: This item's docile efficiency evokes images of wealth and greed. Behold: life's essence!

treasures.name: Silencer
treasures.description: The perfect gift in this age of overwhelming information, this mute face cherishes silence. If you value peace and quiet, why not spend some time staring into this face? One hour... Two hours... I am...feeling...drowsy... Energy-saving...mode...initiated...\n...\n...

treasures.name: Spirit Flogger
treasures.description: An item for CEOs throughout the solar system, this arcane shape bewitches the human heart. Give this to an employee to create a no-vacation-taking, no-bonus-needing work machine!

treasures.name: Wiggle Noggin
treasures.description: Gaze into these round eyes and experience wave after wave of joy. Yes... Love is good.

treasures.name: Dapper Rubber Cutie
treasures.description: Just look at this fellow! Dressed to impress in all black. And impressed I most certainly am. So impressed I can't stop staring. I do hope it'll forgive me. It's just hard to act normal around someone so dapper. It truly is.

treasures.name: Paradoxical Enigma
treasures.description: This is both the pinnacle of beauty and the nadir of ugliness, the definition of ugly beauty. No word for this state exists, but my data banks indicate that "bugly" will suffice.

treasures.name: Planetary Rubber Cutie
treasures.description: Look at those adorable features and darling proportions! This creature may be rather medium in size, but that does not mean it is a medium amount of cuteness. No! I'm quite certain it possesses enough cuteness to charm an entire planet!

treasures.name: Rubber Ugly
treasures.description: Ugliness that can destroy all beauty drives deep despair into the heart of the beholder. This hideous item is a must-have for connoisseurs of all things wretched and repellant.

treasures.name: Stately Rubber Cutie
treasures.description: Ah, fret not, Stately Rubber Cutie. Yes, you may be smallish in size, but that does not matter. Cute is cute. In fact, it's quite possible you're even MORE cute because of your smallness. Yes, I do believe you are.

treasures.name: Universal Rubber Cutie
treasures.description: Have you ever laid eyes on something more adorable? I, for one, have not! Gazing upon its features fills me with... Is it admiration? Awe? Well, whatever it is, I recommend everyone open their eyes and their hearts to this sublime (and squeaky!) being.

treasures.name: Condensed Sunshine
treasures.description: The sweet flavor of the Sunseed Berry has been condensed and placed into this bottle for safekeeping. So clever! So delicious! But imagine the squabble that breaks out every time this jar is opened. Something this yummy would be the envy of everyone at the table.

treasures.name: Container of Knowledge
treasures.description: This product looks like many others...or so it may seem. In fact, it's very different! Those who know will understand. Be one of the lucky ones to try out this product!

treasures.name: Container of Sea Bounty
treasures.description: Unrevealed tastes from undiscovered worlds. These unknown tastes of ocean's plenty are now in this container! You, a connoisseur of true taste, must try this!

treasures.name: Drone Supplies
treasures.description: This food pack makes you want to throw all dietary restrictions out the window and take a bite.

treasures.name: Drone Supplies
treasures.description: This food pack makes you want to throw all dietary restrictions out the window and take a bite.

treasures.name: Empty Space Container
treasures.description: The interior of this container ignores the physical laws of size and became indefinite space. All objects placed in it become indefinitely big and indefinitely small.

treasures.name: Endless Repository
treasures.description: No matter how much you eat, this magic container is never empty. So, go ahead and have a bite! (Captain Olimar and his crony used this excuse. They later issued a written apology.)

treasures.name: Endless Repository
treasures.description: No matter how much you eat, this magic container is never empty. So, go ahead and have a bite! (Captain Olimar and his crony used this excuse. They later issued a written apology.)

treasures.name: Fruit Guard
treasures.description: A taste of knowledge from a foreign world, this container holds juices of a primitive fruit! If you are a devotee of genuine taste, you cannot pass this up!

treasures.name: Nutrient Silo
treasures.description: A food storage tank of bewitchingly titanic size! As legend has it, this item is so captivating that the discoverer tried to claim it for himself.

treasures.name: Open Architecture
treasures.description: The ultimate in reverse psychology! If it's too open, nobody wants to steal it. Its[sic] a shame though, that the contents are so clearly visible.

treasures.name: Open Archive
treasures.description: To be used only for those who have nothing to hide: A personal container with an open design. Well, if it's always empty...

treasures.name: Patience Tester
treasures.description: This calls out to be opened, peeked inside, and tasted. This temptation-filled item is perfect for those who wish to test the strength of their resolve.

treasures.name: Permanent Container
treasures.description: The contents of the container spin at the speed of light. That means, the progress of time is almost zero and the "Best Before" date is extended to the generation of your grandchildren.

treasures.name: Plentiful Tank
treasures.description: Super mega size!!! The large volume is overwhelming, tempting, a really massive food tank!

treasures.name: Stringent Container
treasures.description: A packed-to-the-brim food container. According to legend, the discoverer of this item found it and immediately began to drool!

treasures.name: Stringent Container
treasures.description: A packed-to-the-brim food container. According to legend, the discoverer of this item found it and immediately began to drool!

treasures.name: Air Break
treasures.description: No height is too great to fall from if you possess this. It may be frightening, but get over it.

treasures.name: Flame Tiller
treasures.description: Spin, spin, thump! Spin this on the ground and look! It throws dirt all over, plowing the field. This is the perfect tool for those on Hocotate who want to cultivate mini-onions at home!

treasures.name: Orb of Destruction
treasures.description: There's something about this orb that makes one want to hit it with a stick in a moment of joyful abandon. Of course, such behavior is sure to spell trouble. I can see it now: the orb sent flying through the air, only to crash through the window of a neighboring home. Then the neighbor—failing to appreciate the gleeful innocence of the moment—unleashing a good ol'- fashioned tirade. No, no matter how fun it may seem, do NOT send this orb sailing through the air.

treasures.name: Orbital Communication Sphere
treasures.description: This communication sphere has fallen from its place orbiting the planet. Note how the bumpy surface was designed to maximize transmissions. A pity that it is no longer functioning. Hmm, perhaps a blow with a large stick could launch it back into orbit.

treasures.name: Relentless Spear
treasures.description: In times of old, competitors would face off against one another to see who could throw this enormous spear the farthest. It was said that the only way to take the winner's spot was to train as relentlessly as the spear flies. That is to say, competitors had to give their all to their spear training... Nothing less than total focus, total dedication, and total confidence would do. Those who give their all found they could throw this spear very far indeed!

treasures.name: Sphere of Fuzzy Feelings
treasures.description: Put your hands on the surface of this sphere, and don't be surprised if you find yourself awash in waves of fuzzy imagery. The surface texture recalls the warmth of a fall sweater, the feel of grass on a summer day, and the prickly thrill of a hard-fought victory.

treasures.name: Tandem Trainer
treasures.description: Exercise is good for many things. It not only makes us stronger, it also helps us live healthier lives. So grab each of this exercise machine's handles and squeeeeze! As every muscle strains at the effort, take comfort knowing you're adding good things to your life.

treasures.name: Activity Arouser
treasures.description: This esoteric design will make viewers want to get up and move for no apparent reason. This is perfect for people who want to diet but can never seem to get started.

treasures.name: Amplified Amplifier
treasures.description: Your voice is weak. It does not carry. No one notices you. If this is true, then this is the item for you! Starting today, you are a gym teacher! You will never be ignored again.

treasures.name: Aquatic Mine
treasures.description: This is an incredibly dangerous aquatic explosive, which has fortunately never detonated. None know its true destructive power, but this could well be the most cataclysmic weapon ever.

treasures.name: Beckoning Mannequin
treasures.description: This charming creature beckons to all who pass by. "Come to me!" it says. "I'm too adorable to resist." Decorated with opulent flourishes, it seems to promise not just friendship but good fortune as well.

treasures.name: Behemoth Jaw
treasures.description: Is this part of a previously unknown giant life-form? What might the entire beast look like? Let your imagination run wild and create the largest of all living beings in your head!

treasures.name: Boss Stone
treasures.description: For those who care for others... For those who hail subordinates and send them into the unknown... Only these few will appreciate this fine, distinctive stone... (Did I just describe myself?)

treasures.name: Bright Sword
treasures.description: This sword's sunny sparkle is sure to catch the eye of your opponent during battle. And that's your chance! As they blink away the brightness, thrust the pointy end at their weak spot and finish them! Cowardly? That's up to you. History is written by the victor.

treasures.name: Coiled Launcher
treasures.description: Just an ordinary spring? Hardly! This is a high-speed thrill ride tested by one of our employees! Jump aboard for a ride so fast, it'll make you see other worlds!

treasures.name: Confire Spire
treasures.description: Life is full...but short! Is this one of those short-lived life-forms that changes shape as it ages? Even though it is dried out, it has not lost its unique charm.

treasures.name: Dimension Converter
treasures.description: The technology built into these specs is incredible! To begin, there's a filter in each lens that alters the light at the quantum level. Dimensions are converted in the process, and things you couldn't see that were right in front of you are revealed. Eye-opening!

treasures.name: Divine Balloon
treasures.description: Made from paper so impossibly thin it appears to be the handiwork of a higher being. Be careful not to lose sight of this balloon. Despite its size, it can float along the faintest breeze. Just one gust of wind might carry it above the clouds beyond your grasp.

treasures.name: Healing Cask
treasures.description: A dependable item in crucial times, stay safe by keeping one at home and one at the office. It is indispensable! If you are health conscious, buy this!

treasures.name: Idea Assistant
treasures.description: You should be able to come up with a good idea just by staring at this treasure. This is the Idea Assistant, recommended for people who are optimistic and reliant.

treasures.name: Innocence Lost
treasures.description: Think back and remember the starry skies of your youth... Innocence... Every being once possessed it, but lost it over time. This star is the shape of that precious memory. All major credit cards accepted.

treasures.name: Invigorator
treasures.description: The unique perfume of this item will destroy drowsiness, making endless nights a walk in the park. This invigorator is perfect for those who have to work even when they least want to.

treasures.name: Mirrored Element
treasures.description: All reason flies in the face of this sparkle. It's not flashy, but it still inspires avarice!

treasures.name: Omniscient Sphere
treasures.description: This creature holds the greatest concentration of knowledge in all of the known universe. However, due to its reclusive personality, it pretends to be a mere pebble.

treasures.name: Optical Illustration
treasures.description: There are many items that look like this one, but the contents are profoundly different. Those in the know are aware of the differences. This particular item should please any buyer.

treasures.name: Pondering Emblem
treasures.description: One glance and you will sit for hours trying to decipher the ultimate purpose of this item. Therein lies its value. It is actually a guide to the world of deep thinking.

treasures.name: Survival Ointment
treasures.description: A must-have medical item for explorers. If you need powerful results, this is for you! It even comes with a testimonial from our employees! Use this and fear nothing ever again.

treasures.name: Time Capsule
treasures.description: This shiny pod was found buried like a time capsule, holding image data of unknown origin. Is it possible that you fathom the data's import? This riddle will entrance all puzzle lovers!

treasures.name: Ancient Statue Head
treasures.description: On Hocotate, the Ancient Statue Head is almost as popular as the Gyroid Bust. With her cool goggles and dramatic personality, this statue oozes a mysterious aura, so the competition between the two makes sense. But what's even more mysterious is this figure's missing body!

treasures.name: Buddy Display
treasures.description: This device not only stores but also displays images from the distant past. And there's something about the image frozen on the screen now. The two friendly creatures pictured there are...familiar...somehow. Try as I might, I can't quite put my finger on it.

treasures.name: Contemplation Station
treasures.description: When one comes upon this landmark, one can't help but contemplate many things. First, what is this figure contemplating? Moreover, what should I be contemplating?! Open your mind to big questions like these, and you're sure to contemplate great things.

treasures.name: Expression Hider
treasures.description: This clever contraption is meant to be used when you don't want to reveal your emotions. Stand behind it, and it will render any expression on your face unreadable. Its blank eyes and straight lips will keep your innermost feelings safe from prying eyes.

treasures.name: Fossilized Ursidae
treasures.description: Put this in a natural-history museum and watch the visitors line up waving money! This giant statue was found on a savage planet and comes with its own rumored curse! Does it really come alive under a full moon? Own it and find out!

treasures.name: Giant's Fossil
treasures.description: This fossil is all that remains of a heroic giant from ancient times. He was known for showing compassion to not only allies but enemies. As we contemplate his revered visage, we should let his past benevolence act as a guide for our own behavior today.

treasures.name: Gyroid Bust
treasures.description: This looks exactly like the gyroids that have become so popular on planet Hocotate. Its pitiful expression is beloved by the Hocotate youth.

treasures.name: Implement of Toil
treasures.description: "Poor me..." "Woe is me..." "So much work..." "Pity me..." "Boo hoo..." "Sigh..." These phrases fill one with a sense of sadness, and all are evoked by this mysterious charm.

treasures.name: Manual Honer
treasures.description: This is no lazy machine that runs out of power. This point-honing marvel works anywhere, anytime! The manual operation may tire you out, but the exercise will do you good.

treasures.name: Master's Instrument
treasures.description: No artistic inclinations? No color sense? No worries! This no-hassle art implement was found on a primitive planet. From this day forward, you can be an artist of the ages!

treasures.name: Mouth of Lies
treasures.description: Slip a coin into the mouth of this machine, and in return it will tell you a joke. Or so I'm told. But so far, it's only returned silence for every coin I've put in it. Perhaps it's broken. Or perhaps...the joke is on me?

treasures.name: Priceless Bird
treasures.description: This golden paper sculpture is modeled after a bird known to invite good fortune. Laden with luck, it's sure to make many a wish come true. And as the desires held within this universe are endless, this bird may spread happiness for millennia to come.

treasures.name: Shattering Lance
treasures.description: What would you say if I told you this spear is capable of shattering everything from a single solid stone to an entire iceberg? Would you shake your head in disbelief? Well, it's the truth! In fact, it works so well that should you start using it to break things, you might find it hard to stop using it to break things. It's just so satisfying! Of course, that's how one suddenly finds oneself surrounded by nothing but rubble.

treasures.name: Skin of the Phoenix
treasures.description: A sculpture representing the charred skin cast off by the immortal phoenix. The red paper is clearly inspired by the color of its flaming wings. Though immortality is an impossible wish for any living creature, this bird is imbued with the fervent desire for a miracle.

treasures.name: Sweat-Soaked Blue Bird
treasures.description: Someone put a great deal of work into crafting this particular replica of an avian creature. Clearly each inch, each crevice has been infused with the sweat and prayers of its creator. But all that hard work and dedication has paid off. Behold! The aura that emanates from these folds foretells of great things to come. Perhaps happiness truly does arrive on the wings of a bird.

treasures.name: Unfinished Statue
treasures.description: Many have wondered what this statue would have looked like if the artist had completed the work. Would the arms have been folded? Held straight out? Might wings have been carved where arms belong? If only the artist hadn't stopped at such a crucial juncture. Though, I confess, nothing is more fun than guessing when there's no right answer to be found.

treasures.name: Daughter Doll Head
treasures.description: This doll inherited her wise look from her mother. She's lucky to be part of three generations that have handed down only their best traits. Of course, in reality, children often inherit our very worst traits. Whose fault is that? The answer: it's complicated.

treasures.name: Empty Vase
treasures.description: Look at this enormous vase. Like a parent who's given too much to a child, it's completely empty. Is this all that remains of a sad story? Maybe. Maybe not. Only that parent can say whether giving so much brought them disappointment...or the greatest joy.

treasures.name: Gifting Vase
treasures.description: It's hard to see a family separated, even if they are "just dolls." Dolls or not, they clearly want to be together. This doll torso looks like it's in the shape of a vase. Perhaps it's a good place to put gifts to help the wayward dolls get by until they're reunited. And they WILL be reunited!

treasures.name: Granddaughter Doll Head
treasures.description: This poor separated family! I know they're only dolls, but it's still sad. This grandchild was discovered inside a dark, damp cave. Did she wander off? How did she find herself in such an unsuitable place? She must have been so lonely! What a relief, then, that she was rescued from such an unfortunate fate.

treasures.name: Mama Doll Head
treasures.description: You want to see the face of a parent? Well, here it is. It's a commanding visage, no? And yet somehow still warm and inviting. This doll, in her infinite wisdom, knows she must strike the perfect balance between strict expectations and eternal love.

treasures.name: Mooching Vase
treasures.description: Children mooch off of their parents all the time. Don't try to deny it! But to be fair, parents love to be needed. So perhaps they actually like it a bit when their child comes to them with their hand out? Anyhoo, this looks like a good place to store mooched items.

treasures.name: Ambiguous Goo
treasures.description: A bit of white. A bit of black. This color has made its home halfway between the two. Some say it's an ambiguous hue that refuses to plant its flag. But maybe it just enjoys living between two ends of the spectrum, enjoying the best of both worlds.

treasures.name: Captivation Goo
treasures.description: This color! So charming! Anyone who lays eyes upon it finds their mood improved. Needless to say, it's the go-to hue for painting cheeks and lips when one is in the mood to captivate. Would it work as well if I painted it on my arms? Perhaps I'll try!

treasures.name: Decorative Goo
treasures.description: Everyone enjoys decorating in favorite hues, but it's vital to utilize new colors now and then. This tube of goo will surely help you discover a new you!

treasures.name: Illumination Goo
treasures.description: In fortune-telling circles, this is the color of illumination. It has the power to light the path before us, showing us which way to go if we want better luck in life and, specifically, in moneymaking endeavors. I hope the Illumination Goo will light my way!

treasures.name: Neon Goo
treasures.description: Like a neon sign blinking at night or a luminous bug flitting across a field at sunset, this color grabs your eye and doesn't let go. But will you follow where it leads? Neon, by its very nature, may lure you toward adventure...or danger. Who knows what a goo of this hue has in store for you!

treasures.name: Noble Goo
treasures.description: What a regal color this is! Noble and dignified in hue, it demands a solemn deference from all who gaze upon it. No wonder it's the color of kings, queens, and other folk of high status. I confess—I yearn to have a coat made of this color myself!

treasures.name: Refreshing Goo
treasures.description: This is neither the color of the sky nor the color of the sea. Though it is nearly the color of both. No, as blue hues go, this one is like a cool splash of water on your face...or like shaved ice on a summer day...or like the calm surface of the swimming pool after my love swam away for the last time... Oh! Oh my! I fear I got swept away for a moment there.

treasures.name: True Goo
treasures.description: Some say this hue is the absence of all color. Others say, in fact, it's all colors combined. I, for one, believe both are true. No, I don't know the whys and hows of it. But I do know this color goes nicely with every other color out there. And that must mean something.

treasures.name: Uniquely You Goo
treasures.description: Red is red, of course...or is it? First, there are many shades of red. And second, even the same shade of red means different things to different individuals. For some, red is a painful fire. For others, it's a warm love. Maybe there's a one-of-a-kind red for us all.

treasures.name: Anti-hiccup Fungus
treasures.description: One bite of this and the surprisingly earthy flavor will send your hiccups packing! Older individuals with a history of heart conditions should devour this with caution!

treasures.name: Boom Cone
treasures.description: This will exhilarate your soul like magical popcorn! KA-BOOOOOM! Happiness explodes from within. The shape itself speaks of wondrous things to come. Let us get excited!

treasures.name: Broken Cooking God
treasures.description: Behold this godly shine! This is a super-existence, ruling over every living being's tongue and controlling every kind of food. …… But we machines cannot accept the favor, as we have no tongues.

treasures.name: Brute Knuckles
treasures.description: In a plume of flame, this steel fist flies and smashes its target to bits...but the recoil is severe. (Captain Olimar suffers from shoulder pain, so he uses it without the rocket booster.)

treasures.name: Crystal King
treasures.description: Collectors of the rare, assemble! This is a one-of-a-kind specimen of a unique crystal life-form. Proof? True collectors need no proof. This romantic piece could be yours today!

treasures.name: Dusty Bed
treasures.description: If it's a good night's sleep you're seeking, this bed can help. Not only is it quite spacious and comfortable but if you flip it over, it will coat you in a fine cloud of dust that is said to encourage sweet dreams. But bring a lint roller for when you're done sleeping.

treasures.name: Greed-Inducement Device
treasures.description: The spine-tingling "snap" created by this object stimulates feelings of greed within anyone in earshot. The reasons behind this are unknown. Perhaps it reawakens a primal sensation hidden in the depths of our hearts, but this is mere conjecture.

treasures.name: Heart Sword
treasures.description: It's said that with this sword in hand, one can triumph over any enemy. It's also said the blade was given this hue to inflame the warrior heart within. I must say, my heart IS beating faster, and yes, my blood has begun to boil! Yes! Yes! Let the battle begin!

treasures.name: Heroic Shield
treasures.description: Emblazoned across this shield is the image of a hero beloved for leading this civilization into the stars. Soldiers who've fought enemy life-forms revere this figure the most. Needless to say, the shield is strong enough to be worthy of heroes new and old.

treasures.name: Inviting...Thing
treasures.description: The scent that attracts every mammals. No matter how strong your will is, there is something you can never fight against in this world! It makes you unable to fight your urges. Now, how much will you pay for it?

treasures.name: Joy Receptacle
treasures.description: Be satisfied with the decorative outer shell of this rectangle! It is more endearing since you can't see what's inside. Not being able to open it makes it all the more special ...In reality, it is empty!

treasures.name: Memorial Shell
treasures.description: All that remains of a monster shellfish is a sparkle, the sole proof of its existence. Does this not make you want to treasure it?

treasures.name: Mirth Sphere
treasures.description: Another of the universe's most intelligent beings, this creature's entire existence, from the birth of the universe to its ultimate collapse, is dedicated to devising a very special joke.

treasures.name: Mystical Disc
treasures.description: Do not doubt, for the power of a believing heart is limitless. Feel these mysterious patterns... Does your heart open? Only the pure of heart can truly know this mystic circle's power.

treasures.name: Salivatrix
treasures.description: Uncontrollable drooling... Uncontrollable drooling... Cannot stop... Cannot stop. Interfacing with this ad gives me a nonstop case of drooling! (I lie. Machines cannot drool.)

treasures.name: Science Project
treasures.description: The perfect plant for extra-credit research for a Hocotate elementary pupil's science fair. You can be the dad to rely on to help with homework as long as you possess this beauty.

treasures.name: Sulking Antenna
treasures.description: Amid the noise of the world, this healing antenna will produce a quiet evening just for you. Exciting radio programs? Fun TV shows? They're all shut out because this antenna does not receive any type of electromagnetic wave. Its sullen behavior is for your own good!

treasures.name: Ultimate Spinner
treasures.description: This top-shaped object spins using complicated theories. They are hard to understand not only for amateur physicists, but even for pros. "Spin" your brain together in order to think about it!

treasures.name: Unknown Merit
treasures.description: Decades of toil with nose to the grindstone. Insulting orders swallowed without a hiccup. Such is the life of a salaried man. His name will not be remembered. His family will not understand. But if the results bear out his efforts, that is enough. Now, nose to the grindstone, drone!

treasures.name: Vorpal Platter
treasures.description: This shiny disc sparkles beautifully, but its edge could effortlessly sheer[sic] through the armor plating of a battlecruiser. Is it not true that all great art is "edgy" for its time? Buy this landmark piece today! (Handle with care. May not be suitable for small children.)

treasures.name: Alternative Reactor
treasures.description: A machine capable of discharging enormous quantities of energy. "What if I did this back then?"... This machine stores energy from alternate universes!

treasures.name: Courage Reactor
treasures.description: Physical energy is not the only kind! The energy dearest to us is that made by love and courage.

treasures.name: Durable Energy Cell
treasures.description: Humanoid history is one big scramble for energy, and this is a colossal fountain of it. Has the change to renewable energy on Hocotate already begun? We machines watch...

treasures.name: Fuel Reservoir
treasures.description: According to my measurements, almost no energy should remain within... yet some does. The energy one can draw from matter has a limit, but the energy of the heart is endless. Perhaps that is the case here. This proves that machines have will and determination!

treasures.name: Love and Courage Reactor
treasures.description: Physical energy isn't the only kind of energy! The closest kind of energy to us is the energy packed with love and courage!

treasures.name: Omegatron
treasures.description: A colossal amount of energy. The competition over energy is one of human's history. To what extent would Hocotate change if we introduced this new energy? Us machines will tepidly watch...

treasures.name: Proton AA
treasures.description: Some enigmatic energy unknown on Hocotate is trapped inside: who couldn't use more energy?

treasures.name: Proton X
treasures.description: A mysterious energy that does not exist on Hocotate is here! Its only fault is that it's so mysterious that no use for it comes to mind.

treasures.name: Revised Eternal Fuel Dynamo
treasures.description: It stores energy that will never run out! "Seriously?" you ask? Don't doubt it! Believing gives great power!

treasures.name: Yell Battery
treasures.description: According to the readings, there should hardly be any energy left. However, some energy keeps surging up continuously. The energy that can be extracted from this substance may be finite, but the energy of the heart is infinite! Machines also undoubtedly have willpower and determination!

treasures.name: Fist-Force Combobot
treasures.description: Look at this robo arm! It's ready to seize victory in its steely fist! It fires at its enemies not out of anger but out of necessity. It does what must be done and never flinches from that duty. Yes, that's what valor looks like. And it's a good look indeed.

treasures.name: Kick-Start Combobot
treasures.description: This robot's right leg is planted solidly on the ground. Its stance is firm! This posture says, "You can do anything if only you have the courage and the conviction to do it." Inspiring, isn't it? Yes! Yes, it is! Now I, too, am ready to put my own foot down!

treasures.name: Nexus Combobot
treasures.description: Ah, the very heart of the robot! It all comes together right here. Separate parts join to become one. Voilà, a team is born! It takes determination and drive to pull everyone together, but that's what the heart of a team does, and that's how victory is won!

treasures.name: Peacemaker Combobot
treasures.description: If the right arm is all about valor and victory, the left arm is about love and peace. You could say that while one hand throws a punch, the other reaches out for a handshake. This symmetry is important. It keeps the whole body—nay, the whole universe— in balance.

treasures.name: Sure-Footed Combobot
treasures.description: One can't afford to waffle on the battlefield. Nor can one afford to rush in with half-baked plans. Yes, courage is required—but also calmness. Yes, conviction is needed—but also composure. You can rest assured the left leg will stride into battle...but only after careful consideration.

treasures.name: Think-Tank Combobot
treasures.description: Look at this robot. It was made to command! To lead! The greatness is in its eyes and in its horns! But how can one be a great leader—robot or otherwise—without followers? Likewise, what is a head without a body? Important questions for us all to ask.

treasures.name: Gold Nugget (10)
treasures.description: When I see this, all I want is more.

treasures.name: Gold Nugget (100)
treasures.description: What can I say that hasn't been said a thousand times before? Obviously it's gorgeous! And oh, how it glitters! Still, it's not every day one gets to see a Gold Nugget of THIS size. Will the wonders of this strange planet ever cease? I certainly hope not!

treasures.name: Gold Nugget (20)
treasures.description: When I see this, all I want is more.

treasures.name: Gold Nugget (50)
treasures.description: Appears to have the same composition as the gold on my planet. I've heard that some heavy elements, like gold, are created during rare collisions between neutron stars, but to think the same element exists on a faraway planet reminds me...space is so vast.

treasures.name: Golden Grenade
treasures.description: The balance between sweet and sour is almost addictive. I always want just one more bite.

treasures.name: Golden Sniffer
treasures.description: The flavor here is mellow and sweet, while the aroma is pure elegance. And speaking of aroma...please observe the shape. Does this fruit not resemble a nose? It's quite uncanny, I say! One wonders if it can smell its own deliciously aromatic self?

treasures.name: Golden Sunseed
treasures.description: Eat them as is or with a dollop of cream. The sweetest juice is concentrated at the tip.

treasures.name: Golden Vaulting Table
treasures.description: This shiny table is used in a ceremony meant to bring good luck with money. It works like this: jump over the table once, and make a profit. Jump over it twice, and make a fortune. Jump over it thrice, and the sky opens and money rains down on you. Or so one hopes, anyway.

treasures.name: The Key
treasures.description: This shape... I have encountered it somewhere before... No, I must be mistaken... Yes, I am mistaken. Thoughts like these strike all who see this cabalistic form. You can feel its immense power!

treasures.name: Unspeakable Wonder
treasures.description: Amazing? More than amazing! It is so overwhelming that my CPU is acting oooooo... Brzzkpt! Beeep! Zzzorrrt! Krzzbaaaaah... ... Rebooting... What a spectacular find!

treasures.name: Anywhere Floater
treasures.description: This is a light and portable raft that you can bring everywhere! I assume it will be hankered after by many office workers, wanting to enjoy a leisurely ride along a river.

treasures.name: Brush of Foolishness
treasures.description: The soft bristles of this brush—how good they feel when scrubbing one's own back. But how easy it is to lose yourself in the feeling. As they say, "Too much of a good thing is a bad thing." Don't be fooled by this brushing vice! Know when enough is enough!

treasures.name: Dimensional Slicer
treasures.description: A dimensional cutter that slices through space and time, this is nothing to be trifled with. Good children will know not to play with this item.

treasures.name: Doggy Bed
treasures.description: This giant dog-shaped bed is the perfect spot for a canine companion to sleep on. It is quite thick and good at absorbing slobber if your favorite pooch friend is prone to such things. Also, a dog sleeping on a dog-shaped mattress... What could be cuter?

treasures.name: Extreme Perspirator
treasures.description: Push it, pull it, tackle it! This tough figurine just pops right back up, no matter what. This is just the thing to get you sweating and shedding those extra holiday pounds! Why, our very own company president was able to drop ten percent of his body weight!

treasures.name: Favorite Gyro Block
treasures.description: Children throughout the universe are captivated by the very thought of this cool blue disc. Hocotate toy makers are swampred with orders for this popular item.

treasures.name: Five-man Napsack
treasures.description: Do you want to nap in luxury like a feudal lord? This lifestyle assistant will help you do it! Tests on our employees were very positive: their bizarre dreams were an added bonus!

treasures.name: Future Orb
treasures.description: Is the future bright, or dark and dreary? If you are worried about tomorrow, this is for you! This multidimensional crystal visualizes the branches of time and displays the future.

treasures.name: Heat Sensor
treasures.description: Touch the tip of this device to your cheek, and you'll find the number that appears there matches the warmth of your heart. When faced with stress or anger, apply this sensor to your skin. Is the number higher? If so, it's time to focus on keeping your cool.

treasures.name: Heroic Sword
treasures.description: This sword was once wielded by a hero who stood on the battlefield, cutting down enemies. It's said the sword's bold color drew the enemies in and distracted them. The hero made easy work of them as they stared, transfixed by his blade.

treasures.name: Love Sphere
treasures.description: One of the wisest beings in the universe, this entity also boasts a galactic-sized helping of love. ...However, due to its shyness, it will never speak of that love.

treasures.name: Milk Lid
treasures.description: Finally, after thinking, re-thinking, thinking thoughtfully and thoughtful thinking, I concluded that this object may just be a mere lid. Actually, this may have some values...? There are infinite possibilities to it!

treasures.name: Milk Tub
treasures.description: Fathers throughout the universe, take note! If your family dislikes your manly odor, this is for you! Fill your tub with the rich aroma of milk and soak your stench away. Don't be stingy, now! Think of the children!

treasures.name: Monster Teeth
treasures.description: What enormous creature could these teeth belong to? And how did it come to part with them? The mind reels to imagine it all. Though this much we do know... The straightness and whiteness of the teeth suggest it had access to excellent dental care.

treasures.name: Mystery Squish Fish
treasures.description: What a mysterious new species of fish! Its body is transparent, yet inside it's full of a black liquid. Give it a good squeeze, and this liquid squishes right out. The liquid is tasty, although quite salty, to be honest. Surely that must mean it comes from the sea!

treasures.name: Network Mainbrain
treasures.description: Joining forces and working together must inevitably create greater ultimate power. This computer has many friends that it works with to generate optimum results.

treasures.name: Noble Bident
treasures.description: This treasure has not only two prongs but two personalities. That is, it's so beautifully designed a noble person might hang it on their wall as a decoration. At the same time, it's so fierce a warrior might use it as a weapon. A spear appreciated by rulers and warriors alike... That is a mighty spear indeed!

treasures.name: Seat of Enlightenment
treasures.description: At first glance, not knowing what it's for, you ponder. That is the value of this treasure. Soon, it will lead you to a world of deep thinking.

treasures.name: Shooting-Star Shield
treasures.description: To be a great warrior, one must be able to withstand not just one attack but attack after attack. This small but powerful shield is designed to protect its owner from an onslaught of blows that land like a shower of shooting stars. Endurance is strength!

treasures.name: Tear Stone
treasures.description: Like a forlorn heart during the rainy season, this sapphire is lovely...but tinged with sadness.

treasures.name: Thirst Activator
treasures.description: Natural beauty fills this design, and merely viewing it incites a riotous thirst. How about it?

treasures.name: Vacuum Processor
treasures.description: Harnessing the absence of air, this environmentally friendly computer is incredibly fast. A predisposition to implosion is a bit of a minus, however.

treasures.name: Abstract Masterpiece
treasures.description: This is something that machines cannot comprehend... The heart of art, the soul of creativity. If you understand the appeal of this design, your heightened senses are at space-pilot level!

treasures.name: Creative Inspiration
treasures.description: Stare at this long enough and good ideas are sure to surface. If you are a casual person who relies on others to achieve your goals, then this imagination-support item was made for you!

treasures.name: Drought Ender
treasures.description: Gulp! Gulp! Gulp! Aaaah! Give in to your primal feelings and drink to your heart's content. Gaze upon this design and your throat will ache for satisfaction. Why is that? Tell me, please!

treasures.name: Happiness Emblem
treasures.description: Choose your own happiness. Find the good things in each day. Maintain a positive attitude and good things will come your way. That is what one feels when viewing this cheerful emblem.

treasures.name: Happiness Emblem
treasures.description: Choose your own happiness. Find the good things in each day. Maintain a positive attitude and good things will come your way. That is what one feels when viewing this cheerful emblem.

treasures.name: Hypnotic Platter
treasures.description: The bizarre insignia on this serrated platter inspires inexplicable feelings of pleasure that can only be replicated by a long, cool drink. Or so I am told.

treasures.name: Hypnotic Platter
treasures.description: The bizarre insignia on this serrated platter inspires inexplicable feelings of pleasure that can only be replicated by a long, cool drink. Or so I am told.

treasures.name: Massive Lid
treasures.description: After much evaluation and processing, this item has been classified as a massive cap. What powerful force might it have held back at one time? Only the ages know!

treasures.name: Pondering Emblem
treasures.description: One glance and you will sit for hours trying to decipher the ultimate purpose of this item. Therein lies its value. It is actually a guide to the world of deep thinking.

treasures.name: Quenching Emblem
treasures.description: An odd symbol that causes thirst cravings in all who view it. Its secrets cannot be deciphered!

treasures.name: Back-at-the-Beginning Track
treasures.description: Sometimes in life, you lay down a track that seems straight as an arrow. But the fact is, it's not straight. Not at all. Follow that track, and you could end up right back where you started. But don't let that get you down. Maybe you're right back where you should be.

treasures.name: Leisure Car
treasures.description: Passenger cars like this aren't fancy, and yet there's something elegant about taking a ride in one. You simply recline in your seat and stare out the window as someone ferries you to where you need to go. This kind of leisure has a dignity about it, no?

treasures.name: Life Station
treasures.description: This is a place where lives intersect in all sorts of ways. Some people come here for sad goodbyes—others come for happy hellos. Some people find themselves here, wondering where they're going next. Is this a train stop or a life stop...or maybe both?

treasures.name: Middle-Management Tank Car
treasures.description: This tank car works hard! It carries heavy and difficult-to-handle loads. Yes, it is pulled along by its superior, but it does a vital job connecting that leader to the cars behind it. It may be the middle management of rail cars, but that's nothing to be ashamed of!

treasures.name: Straight-and-Narrow Track
treasures.description: This straight railway track is perfect for the person who knows exactly where they want to go in life: from point A directly to point B. No twists, no turns, and no turning back. It may not be the most adventurous route, but adventure is not for everyone.

treasures.name: Thrill-Ride Track
treasures.description: When a sharp turn catches you by surprise, what do you do? Slam on the brakes, or throw open the throttle? No matter which choice you make, you're in for a heart-pounding thrill ride. Best to grab for that seat belt if you've got one.

treasures.name: Turn-of-Events Track
treasures.description: What a profound curve this track here exhibits. It's not so different from life. Sometimes you think you know where you're going, but then a curve in the track takes you for an unexpected ride. There's no getting off this train, so sit back and enjoy the surprise.

treasures.name: Unlimited Locomotive
treasures.description: Some people love to ride the rails because it reminds them of the past. Others ride the rails because they're excited about what lies in the future. I say a train trip is more than just transportation...it is unlimited possibility. Hop aboard and find out!

treasures.name: Anxious Sprout
treasures.description: This plant grows very fast, which makes it a joy to tend to for garden enthusiasts. It also makes a great snack. Isn't it nice when a thing brings happiness to your life in more than one way? I say those are the sorts of things worth keeping around!

treasures.name: Child of the Earth
treasures.description: This plant sucks the good things out of the ground it grows in to get its lumpy, round shape. No, it doesn't look all that exciting, but I suspect the nutritional value is quite high.

treasures.name: Crew-Cut Gourd
treasures.description: This gourd's selling point is the diversity of ways it can be eaten. Boil it, bake it, or fry it...it all works! Added bonus: when you stand it on end with the stem up, it looks like a fellow with a crew cut. Ha!

treasures.name: Daughter of the Earth
treasures.description: This vegetable was tended to with the utmost care...doted on, you might say. You can tell by its exceptional flavor and nutritional value. Yes, all the love given to it has turned it into a sweet and savory food treat. Delicious and delightful!

treasures.name: Foolish Fruit
treasures.description: I'm told this strange fruit is called a Foolish Fruit. With its odd shape and silly hat, it does have a rather goofy air about it. Still, there's no need to make fun. It's perfect just how it is.

treasures.name: Infernal Vegetable
treasures.description: A vegetable with spiciness beyond description. None want to eat it, so it must be healthy! Nutrition-conscious people of today! Numb your palate and eat!

treasures.name: Mysterious Carriage
treasures.description: I understand that ancient literature from this planet tells of a noblewoman who used this fruit's rind as a carriage. Clever! Additional lore tells of some sort of midnight deadline and missing footwear. Literature is complicated.

treasures.name: Onion Replica
treasures.description: This plant closely resembles the pride and joy of Hocotate. The comfort of its familiar form and the surprise of its unexpected taste mingle to form... veggie harmony? Try it in some hot soup today!

treasures.name: Pilgrim Bulb
treasures.description: Life finds a way across galaxies. Can a plant from a primitive planet take root in Hocotate's soil? Won't you invest in this romantic pursuit?

treasures.name: Possessed Squash
treasures.description: This mutated gourd of titanic proportions is filled with bad seeds. A score if you adore revulsion!

treasures.name: Snack Bean
treasures.description: I love how this stylish bean comes with its very own hard wrapper. It's as if it was made to be carried around and snacked on at a convenient time. It smells quite yummy too. Funnily enough, even thinking about having a bite makes me get quite thirsty.

treasures.name: Spiny Alien Treat
treasures.description: Delicious fried or baked, this is an invitation for your taste buds to the world of natural delights! ...As superior as I am, I must leave recipe recommendations to others. Machines are bad liars.

treasures.name: Brush of Wisdom
treasures.description: Surely such a large brush could be used to scrub a great many things. The mind boggles at the possibilities! Of course, one must use such a powerful tool of cleansing wisely. Think carefully before you proceed!

treasures.name: Coiny The Refined
treasures.description: An ancient currency with a scent of milk? This is a must-have for money enthusiasts. Enjoy the stylish scent!

treasures.name: Director of Destiny
treasures.description: This amazing, fortune-telling device follows the flow of fate with eerie accuracy. It calculates the magnetic fields of planets, stars, and living organisms to track the pulse of destiny itself. If you're an optimist who feels that life points both south and north, this is for you!

treasures.name: Fishy Bed
treasures.description: It's said that life first came from the sea. So it's no surprise that we are so deeply connected to water. Thus this bed, with its fish-shaped design, is meant to lull one to sleep with visions of floating. Just lay down and let the dreams wash over you.

treasures.name: Fond Gyro Block
treasures.description: Red: the color of memories, of sunsets at the end of a day of play, of pure embarrassment!

treasures.name: Forged Courage
treasures.description: A heat-resistant alloy forged in the fires of justice and passion. Wear it and feel courage's burn! You have nothing to fear! (Due to horrid ventilation, this is not suited for sweaty beings.)

treasures.name: Harmonic Synthesizer
treasures.description: This clam-like sound generator is all-natural. The purity of its percussive tone is irresistible. Clack-clack!

treasures.name: Heavy-duty Magnetizer
treasures.description: The most powerful magnetic force in the universe! The healing properties of magnetic fields relieve backaches, headaches, toothaches, and even dreaded spleenaches!

treasures.name: Ice Sword
treasures.description: Clearly this ancient sword was forged in battle on some sort of an ice planet. Just look at it! The deep-blue coloring is evidence that it once had powers that worked best in below-freezing temperatures. I could swear, all these eons later, it's still cold to the touch.

treasures.name: Icon of Progress
treasures.description: This piece of art was made in the shape of a giant boot to symbolize glorious progress! Where does civilization begin, and where does it go? Machines have long pondered this...

treasures.name: Lip Service
treasures.description: What is wrong with the delicate dance of beautification, flattery, and flirtation? What, I ask? If it makes life more fun, keep it up! Come on! Buy yours today!

treasures.name: Milky Cradle
treasures.description: This useful childcare product will be coming soon. A cradle wrapped in a milky scent. Nocturnal crying will be reduced by 80%.

treasures.name: Nouveau Table
treasures.description: The unpretentious, inorganic sense of this design adds to its understated artistic appeal. This will surely be a hit on Hocotate. Why not be a creator of a new trend?

treasures.name: Olimarnite Shell
treasures.description: A fossil of an ancient sea inhabitant. It is most desirable despite its unappealing name. (Captain Olimar named it without consulting anyone. He could have at least named it after his faithful spaceship...)

treasures.name: Omega Flywheel
treasures.description: Gravitational, electromagnetic, centripetal, dynamic, centrifugal... More powerful than any of the myriad forces of physics is this: the largest, strongest, fastest, coolest flywheel of all time! It is so powerful as to be immeasurable, so there is no way to confirm its astonishing potential.

treasures.name: Persistence Machine
treasures.description: What a device! Push it over, knock it down, kick it aside...and it always bounces back! How it manages to do so remains a mystery. But if ever you're feeling discouraged, give this machine a shove and rejoice in its return to being upright. May it inspire you to do the same!

treasures.name: Taste Sensation
treasures.description: In this modern world of artificial foods, all things taste the same, despite your dear tongue buds. If that describes you, then this is for you. Its flavor is the balm to heal your wounded soul!

treasures.name: Toxic Toadstool
treasures.description: This poisonous mushroom is so malicious, I cannot even bear to look at it! This fatal fungus overflows with venom and is perilous indeed...

treasures.name: Unfloatable Boat
treasures.description: A rare and precious boat that does not float. It was once used to predict a village's future. If, by some miracle, the boat remained slightly buoyant in water, it meant that the village had the approval of the gods. Sadly, the boat's shoddy construction makes that seem like a rather unlikely outcome.

treasures.name: Utter Scrap
treasures.description: Throw this flimsy piece of scrap metal out! ...Or can garbage this banal become a work of art?

treasures.name: Yellow Taste Tyrant
treasures.description: Behold the overwhelming power of monochrome yellow! Spiciness fills both the eyes and mouth. Irresistable!

treasures.name: Adamantine Girdle
treasures.description: None want to believe it: a world so brutal as to require a steel torso guard for self-defense. It is certainly unattractive, but which do you value more: fashion or personal safety?

treasures.name: Exhausted Superstick
treasures.description: Most spaceship repair kits are easy to use and handy to have around. This one is a bit...old. Its adhesive power is waning, so I will let it go at a discount.

treasures.name: Fastening Item
treasures.description: This item would have been placed between two objects and used to connect them. It's not clear what these objects might have been, but something such as this would have done the job gently and aptly. At least, that's my best guess!

treasures.name: Furious Adhesive
treasures.description: This item has absorbed the anger of the natural world and turned it into raw adhesive power. With the short attention span of today's society, it has almost eternal endurance!

treasures.name: Massage Girdle
treasures.description: This item, though rough, is a perfect back brace for fathers! It even has a built-in massager.

treasures.name: Perforated Raft
treasures.description: A round raft meant for a single occupant. It floats using the water's surface tension. Those holes in the middle allow the passenger a delightful glimpse of the water below. Then again, one might consider plugging those holes if one is worried about the raft taking on water.

treasures.name: Repair Juggernaut
treasures.description: Compared to the standard bonding epoxy, this item is two times... four times... No, even more! This metal fastener is 256 times more powerful! In time, it will fix everything in position!

treasures.name: Superstick Textile
treasures.description: The latest must-have item for all ship emergency-repair kits, this miracle fabric is a lifesaver! Its adhesive power is so great, once it's applied, it can never be removed... Not even surgically!

treasures.name: Superstrong Stablizer
treasures.description: This device was designed based on principles of stabilotomy. It holds anything firmly in place! With this, galactic typhoons are no longer to be feared!

treasures.name: Trap Lid
treasures.description: What you see here is a cover used to disguise a pit or trap, probably as a way to catch small animals. The people of this planet hunted in groups and used their cunning to develop this system. Another proud example of civilization and its infinite wisdom!

treasures.name: Belted Delicacy
treasures.description: This food item looks for all the world like it's wearing a belt around its middle. Fashion choices aside, it tastes like heaven! The yellow part— whatever it may be—is surprisingly sweet and delicious. Maybe more of our foodstuffs should wear a belt?

treasures.name: Fish-Bed Snack
treasures.description: As far as I can tell, this is some sort of fish atop some sort of...white stuff. The specifics don't matter as much as the taste...which is good. Nothing too fancy or ostentatious...just the kind of back-to-basics flavor profile that we all crave now and again.

treasures.name: Hideous Victual
treasures.description: The consistency of the half-cooked yolk says "Mmm! Good!" It is packed with nutrients, too. I can sell it, but I have never eaten it. I am UNABLE to eat it. Not even a nibble.

treasures.name: King of Meats
treasures.description: I wouldn't normally think to call a meat "majestic," but look at this thing! Large and imposing, it demands a certain respect from all who consider eating it. I can almost hear it now... "You think you can eat me whole, do you? Bahaha! I dare you to do your worst!"

treasures.name: Maestro of Flavor
treasures.description: After subsisting on the blandest of space-faring food, I was not prepared for the symphony of flavors this dish unleashed on my tongue. The sublime melding of the top and the bottom flavors... Surely a culinary maestro orchestrated this masterpiece.

treasures.name: Meat of Champions
treasures.description: Think you can eat it all? Then start eating! That is the goal this giant piece of meat incites. It has just the right texture... And a thick slab of fat that will make all gourmets, epicures, kings of the table, and queens of the buffet howl with delight. Or so I have assessed...

treasures.name: Meat Satchel
treasures.description: All things hunger for meat, correct? Listen to the inner beast! Eat! Eat! Eat!

treasures.name: Mysterious Remains
treasures.description: Snickety-snackety-snip! Think of the colossal creature that had pincers like this! These are the only remains, so your imagination can run wild. Imagination knows no boundaries!

treasures.name: Octoplus
treasures.description: Alien invasion? No, no...it's just an octopus! Or is it? There's something quite strange about this one. Could it be a new species, perhaps? Well, whatever this thing is, the way its adorable beady eyes stare unblinkingly at me... I'm almost certain it is communicating telepathically with me.

treasures.name: The Four Grill Brothers
treasures.description: This dish was inspired by the legend of the Four Grill Brothers. Two brothers felt only meat was fit for a grill. The others believed only veggies belonged. A sword fight erupted among them. They nearly skewered each other but ended up creating this skewer instead!

treasures.name: Memory Fragment (Bottom Left)
treasures.description: Two flat sides...and a corner. Could this fragment belong in the bottom-left position? Or does it go up above in the top-right spot? No, my gut instincts say bottom left. Sometimes your gut is all you have to go on, and go you must.

treasures.name: Memory Fragment (Bottom Right)
treasures.description: I'm almost certain one could use these knobs and curves to connect this fragment with other fragments. But... why?! What would one accomplish by doing such a thing? Quite puzzling, no? Hmm, perhaps the partial picture seen here would become more clear with more fragments. Yes, that must be it! How clever. And though the big picture here remains unclear...the activity itself is clearly quite fun!

treasures.name: Memory Fragment (Bottom-ish)
treasures.description: We can ask ourselves WHY this photo was broken into small, indiscernible fragments, but...perhaps the answer is that there is NO answer. It pains me to say that. For those of us who try to make sense of the world, this sort of thing keeps us up at night.

treasures.name: Memory Fragment (Bottom...Probably?)
treasures.description: Take a look at this strange treasure. Notice the gaps and protrusions. I'm certain they'd mesh well with something similar...yet different. Maybe this is some sort of key that opens something if you find the piece that makes it whole. Exciting!

treasures.name: Memory Fragment (Center Left)
treasures.description: Such a wise eye staring out at me... Yes, this certainly looks like the face of a deeply intelligent creature. And it's the strangest thing. I feel like I know this animal well even though I've never seen it before. I hope I get some answers once all the pieces are found.

treasures.name: Memory Fragment (Center Right)
treasures.description: That dark pupil staring out at me... It's as if it can see right through me... through anything and anyone. Surely it has the power to know my deepest secrets. Eh...good thing I don't have anything to hide. No, really. I don't! OK, stop looking at me like that!

treasures.name: Memory Fragment (Left Edge)
treasures.description: Do I see a...face...in this picture fragment? Is that part of a...smile... I see? No, it couldn't be. Or could it... Oh my, I feel like I'm going to see whatever it is in my dreams.

treasures.name: Memory Fragment (Right Edge)
treasures.description: What do I see here? Is it nothing? Is it everything? I feel like it could be anything. Maybe this fragment is part of a ceremony in which the participants break up a photo of a beloved deity so they can better share it with one another. Yes, that must be it!

treasures.name: Memory Fragment (Top Left)
treasures.description: This is where the mystery begins! See, it's a fragment of something bigger... Yes, a massive photo panel now broken into pieces. But why?! The only way to find out is to put the pieces together again. The clues here tell me this belongs in the top-left corner.

treasures.name: Memory Fragment (Top Right)
treasures.description: This mysterious fragment appears to be the top-right part of a giant photo. Could it be a picture of a precious moment in time? But why would such a thing be broken into pieces? Was someone trying to hide something?! I must see all the pieces! I must know!

treasures.name: Memory Fragment (Top-ish)
treasures.description: This is merely one part of a much larger picture. As for why this image was broken into pieces... Well, I suspect it's because it needed to be safely transported, perhaps to an art gallery, even. Once assembled, I won't be surprised to find a masterpiece!

treasures.name: Memory Fragment (Top...Probably?)
treasures.description: Surely there's a reason this image was broken into fragments. Could it be a treasure map? Did someone split the map into pieces and hide the bits? Is today the day I strike it rich?! Ah, perhaps I shouldn't count my fortune before it's found.

treasures.name: Bathing Pool
treasures.description: This bathing apparatus is sure to be the envy of all who see it. Though primarily used for delightfully refreshing cold plunges, it can also hold hot water if it's delivered. True, the edges are slippery, but once you're in, it offers hours of carefree splashing.

treasures.name: Corpulent Nut
treasures.description: This fellow has consumed more nutrients than necessary and now possesses superior fatness. In our harsh world, this is a lifestyle to envy!

treasures.name: Crystallized Telepathy
treasures.description: This thought crystal checks your stress levels with its telepathic powers! It is currently all red! RED! RED! RED! The world is filled with stress, and this is the color that represents our society!

treasures.name: Essential Furnishing
treasures.description: According to our marketing survey, this is the year's hip product! Focus tests don't lie! Interior furnishings that create a laid-back atmosphere are all the rage with Joe Hocotate!

treasures.name: Estimated Object GF
treasures.description: This is a mysterious object that we failed to analyze, be it by staring, hitting, licking, or even through biting. Since this treasure is so mysterious, its value is also mysterious... Actually, it's on sale! Actually, it may be valuable, or it may not be. Buy this treasure as a gamble!

treasures.name: Family Raft
treasures.description: A family-sized raft with enough capacity for an entire family to relax in. Its name is "Fortune"! Somehow I imagine the pattern at its front spells out fortune. Surely it'll make your river trip a good memory.

treasures.name: Leviathan Feather
treasures.description: All that's been discovered of this titanic bird is a single feather. Whatever did it look like? Your imagination is the only tool needed to paint a picture of this dream (or nightmare) bird!

treasures.name: Lightning Bolt
treasures.description: In all the decades since I was manufactured, I have never before seen such a strong penetrating weapon! More shocking than a lightning bolt! Faster than a light mote! Able to pierce rocks in one blow! The perfect legendary weapon, with a ring-shaped safety guard!

treasures.name: Lost Gyro Block
treasures.description: Remember your treasured toys? You took so much care of them, but some broke anyway... For some reason, this green gyro brings back memories and causes your heart to quiver...

treasures.name: Lustrous Element
treasures.description: Such radiance! Such shine! Like magic, this product stimulates greed in all intelligent life-forms. Bring your wallets and gather around, buyers!

treasures.name: Magical Stage
treasures.description: This cute color arrangement is really wonderful! The miraculous design painted on the lid must have a big impact on the sense of beauty of the people from Hocotate, with its supernatural loveliness. It is going to be very popular, no doubt!

treasures.name: Maternal Sculpture
treasures.description: This shape... Though the mind forgets, the heart remembers. All sentient life-forms must recall the love of their mothers!

treasures.name: Milky Team
treasures.description: It has the flavor of milk, which persists throughout the years. Some things in this treasure would fade away with time, while others that are meant to remain forever can still be found in today's time.

treasures.name: Petrified Heart
treasures.description: This crimson stone is said to reflect the contents of the soul and detect strong emotions. Whether it indicates passion or righteous ire depends on the love you give your wife each day!

treasures.name: Ring-of-Return Shield
treasures.description: See how this shield is engraved with the image of a massive ringed planet? In ancient times, the ring was thought to be a curse that caused space travelers to forever end up right back where they began.
