But nowadays, the ring has come to represent a joyful return home after a long journey. It was also customary to give this shield to someone you love in hopes it would bring them home to you safely.

treasures.name: Scrumptious Shell
treasures.description: This flavorful item's texture is most agreeable to any life-form... Or so my data suggests. Do statements like these, from a machine without taste buds, strike you as odd?

treasures.name: Space Spinner
treasures.description: This object rotates with tremendous force if spun along its center axis. Just as its name implies, its design was inspired by the rotational structure of space. Much like with space, you're forced to ask yourself, "Where and when does it all end?"

treasures.name: Treasured Gyro Block
treasures.description: Feel the joy that only collectors can savor, the happiness for those who have found them all. Enjoy this wonderful feeling to your heart's content.

treasures.name: Understood Person Symbol
treasures.description: You can find a lot of items that look like this one. But no matter how similar they look, they have slight differences. Only those in the know will understand. This treasure is a challenge for all buyers.

treasures.name: Sphere of Beginnings
treasures.description: When I stare at this sacred sphere, phrases like "fresh start," "new life," and "clean slate" float before my eyes. The Sphere of Beginnings is revered for its power to open doors and sprout fresh opportunities. It reminds us that a new chapter is always just a page away.

treasures.name: Sphere of Calm
treasures.description: This sphere was painstakingly polished and then hand-painted in the most calming color possible. The deep green here is meant to bring to mind a lush forest, and in doing so, shoo away the stresses of the day. Go on. Gaze upon it. As the stress disappears, allow a sense of well-being to take its place.

treasures.name: Sphere of Desire
treasures.description: It's said this sacred sphere has the power to make the most deeply held desires come true—more so than any other orb in the Sacred Sphere Series. Oh, what greedy wishes must have been wished upon it! Surely the maker of this orb wanted something near unattainable. But who among us hasn't felt such avarice?

treasures.name: Sphere of Family
treasures.description: This sphere is believed to be the patron of families. Parents often implore it to help their children flourish. And who can blame them? Parents treasure their children, who then treasure their own children, and on and on it goes. Such endless love is a beautiful thing.

treasures.name: Sphere of Good Fortune
treasures.description: The symbol painted on the surface of this sphere is believed to bring good luck. The inhabitants here were known to rub the orb before beginning a journey or new undertaking. Did this ritual actually bring them good luck? We shall never know! But let us hope it at least brought them comfort.

treasures.name: Sphere of Heart
treasures.description: It's said there's nothing more difficult to understand than the ways of the heart. It's also said this sphere gives the one who holds it the power to read the heart of the one they love. But is that a good idea? I'm not so sure it is.

treasures.name: Sphere of Support
treasures.description: This sphere is quite unique. That is, it represents the very core—the pillar— at the center of every living being. And to keep our pillars strong, this orb bids us do one simple thing: support one another. What a message! It's one for the ages and the whole universe!

treasures.name: Sphere of Trust
treasures.description: The inhabitants used this treasure in ancient ceremonies as a way to foster trust in their deities as well as in their friends and family. Knowing that trust was so important to them—as it is to us—makes me think that perhaps we aren't so different after all.

treasures.name: Sphere of Truth
treasures.description: Behold this sublime sphere! A shape this flawless does not exist in nature. And so, since ancient times, this orb and others like it have been treated as sacred by the civilization here. Each sphere has its own meaning. This one represents truth of the deepest kind.

treasures.name: Sphere of Vitality
treasures.description: Like those of us today, the ancient civilization here prized good health. But it was harder to come by in the olden times, and so this orb became a powerful charm for bringing vitality to young and old alike. Even now, I feel more alive just looking at it!

treasures.name: Crystal Clover
treasures.description: An emerald in the shape of a four-leaf plant. Its vivid green hue soothes the soul and calls forth joy. Order yours today!

treasures.name: Essence of Desire
treasures.description: Stones, soil, and the stars themselves radiate with delight for this symbol of galactic desire.

treasures.name: Essence of Despair
treasures.description: Long ago, evil forces clashed with the forces of justice... The evil was defeated and locked away in this stone. (Am I evil for making up such a tale? Justice, please look the other way!)

treasures.name: Essence of Rage
treasures.description: The sight of this may warm you when you are cold, a lovely side effect of this valuable treasure.

treasures.name: Essence of True Love
treasures.description: Wash away all your stress and angst with the glory of this enduring symbol of love.

treasures.name: Eternal Emerald Eye
treasures.description: A stone with a subtle twinkle that grants harmony, stability, and tranquility to the beholder.

treasures.name: Floral Instigator
treasures.description: Feeling down? Then simply shake this stick at a dormant tree, and its flowers will immediately come to life! You may ask how this is possible, but mysterious and ancient technology is beyond our comprehension. Simply put, it's magic. Let's just leave it at that, shall we?

treasures.name: Princess Pearl
treasures.description: This stone is for all the fathers who want their daughters to grow up to be elegant, rather than flashy. There is nothing cheap about the sparkle of this stone. It is the gift you have been looking for!

treasures.name: Princess Pearl
treasures.description: It's said a king gave this orb to his beloved daughter and that it contains all the wisdom the princess would need as next ruler of the land. Note it is not especially flashy. One can assume that's because good leadership is not about flash but about substance.

treasures.name: Spouse Alert
treasures.description: Put this on your spouse and you will always know if he or she is approaching. How convenient! A must-have item for couples who like to hide things.

treasures.name: Frosty Bauble
treasures.description: The cold brilliance of this stone will freeze the hearts of all admirers and sap their wills. Men throughout the universe will gaze upon this and be reminded of their wives.

treasures.name: Gemstar Husband
treasures.description: Once again, daydreams come alive! This is not just a fine gem, but a rare, inorganic life-form.

treasures.name: Gemstar Wife
treasures.description: It looks like a common gem, but it is actually a female specimen of a gemstone life-form. Collect a male and a female and they will sparkle in the darkness, longing for one another.

treasures.name: Hoop of Fortune
treasures.description: Do you ever wish you had good luck? With this hoop, you need not wish! Step through its glowing yellow center, and good fortune is sure to follow. Of course, for this to work, it helps if you believed it was going to work in the first place.

treasures.name: Hoop of Healing
treasures.description: Step through this glowing blue hoop, and you will feel its healing effects almost at once. Exhaustion is gone! Ailments of the heart and the body banished! You have but to make the choice to step through it.

treasures.name: Hoop of Passion
treasures.description: Is your relationship missing the spark it once had? Are you stuck in a rut with the one you love? This hoop can help! Step through the glowing pink light, and feel the passion return. The warmth that shines upon you is sure to remind you of the day you met.

treasures.name: Joyless Jewel
treasures.description: Those who view this gem's green twinkle become filled with great hopes and expectations. However, it rewards neither. This artistic sham only provides short-lived happiness.

treasures.name: Pink Menace
treasures.description: This gem holds the shape of the universal symbol of love, yet its cut and light-refracting abilities make it a menacing super-weapon in disguise! It could be used to create a horrifying, doomsday death ray...or something even worse. We peaceful machines live in eternal fear of the ability of living beings to turn anything into a weapon.

treasures.name: Unbreakable Promise
treasures.description: A hoop topped by a stone made of the hardest substance in the universe—a perfect gift to give when making an unbreakable promise! Though...I am told this stone can, in fact, be broken. Perhaps, then, it's meant as a reminder that no promise is truly unbreakable?

treasures.name: Universal Com
treasures.description: This communications monitor was found on an uncivilized planet! Sadly, it is broken and does not work. As such, its purpose cannot be confirmed. Yet...that only heightens its irresistible appeal. Reality...or misperception? Either way, you should buy it!

treasures.name: Crystallized Clairvoyance
treasures.description: This mystic crystal has the ability to channel energy between this world and the next. This spiritual connectivity will act as a life navigator for a positive existence.

treasures.name: Crystallized Telekinesis
treasures.description: This crystal is empowered with psychokinetic abilities. If it is so inclined, it will use its mighty powers to do physical labor in your stead! ...When it will be so inclined is unknown, however.

treasures.name: Don't-See-It Specs
treasures.description: An incredible invention! These glasses block out things you don't want to see while letting you see the things you DO want to see. Is this a healthy way to view the world? I'm not sure it is. But I'm also not here to judge.

treasures.name: False Lollipop
treasures.description: What a surprise it is to find that this lollipop offers no flavor at all. The odd protuberance is neither sweet nor savory...and yet, mysteriously, it lures one into sucking on it. Even more surprising: once you have a taste of this flavorless lollipop, you are almost certain to feel so soothed that hours fly by in a satisfied haze.

treasures.name: Flying Saucer
treasures.description: I don't believe it! I don't want to believe it! Is it true that this is actually a UFO!? It's a mysterious object whose true identity was never fully settled, even after intense debating between romantics and realists.

treasures.name: Gherkin Gate
treasures.description: This cryptic design contains a link between sight and taste that is unknown on Hocotate. According to the psychology of unknown shapes, gazing at this will let you taste the unknown.

treasures.name: Growshroom
treasures.description: Eat one of these and grow to twice your normal size! Perfect for skinny beings unable to pack on any girth.

treasures.name: Impediment Scourge
treasures.description: More shocking than a lightning bolt! Faster than a light mote! Able to crush rocks in one bash! This device can clear any impediment in one fell swoop!

treasures.name: Memorable Gyro Block
treasures.description: No matter how old you grow, you will ever remember the treasures of childhood. Take this gift...

treasures.name: Merciless Extractor
treasures.description: Squeeze. Squeeze! Had enough? SQUEEEEEZE! A ruthless, savage heart in machine form! No giant fruit can retain its juice in the face of this relentless wringing device. If you are greedy down to the last drop, this is for you!

treasures.name: Paper Slider
treasures.description: This slider has an extremely light bodyweight, a small recessed shape on its inwards, and a slippery bottom! There's no reason to not use this as a slider. With this, the sliding king's throne is now yours!

treasures.name: Regal Diamond
treasures.description: This scintillating jewel will make girlfriends feel like queens of the galaxy and boyfriends feel like kings of debt. Fit for the ruler of the universe, it is the ultimate giant diamond.

treasures.name: Repugnant Appendage
treasures.description: Is this the remains of some giant creature? Its color is striking, but its stench is horrific. Could it be dangerous? The true essence of things in the natural world is very often disguised. Be fooled and die...fool or be killed. This is a law of survival.

treasures.name: Satellite Shield
treasures.description: Did you know that satellites are highly vulnerable to meteors and other space debris? This shield was specially made for space workers who protected these vital pieces of tech from damage. If this shield can withstand a blow from a meteor, it can withstand anything!

treasures.name: Secured Satchel
treasures.description: Store your valuables in this bag for guaranteed peace of mind. Of course, that's easier said than done. Its defenses make it impregnable and virtually impossible to break. But that's only a problem if you want to see your possessions ever again.

treasures.name: Shake-a-Smile
treasures.description: Crying when you want to cry, laughing when you want to laugh, acting on your every impulse without worrying about the consequences... Ah, to be a baby again. This treasure elicits feelings of nostalgia for that time and memories of the love and joy a baby can bring.

treasures.name: Slipper-Bug Fossil
treasures.description: Clearly this is a fossil of a slipper bug. These creatures lived in ancient times and always traveled in pairs. Quite often one would get separated from the other, and no amount of searching would reunite them. Wait... am I thinking about real slippers?

treasures.name: Space Wave Receiver
treasures.description: Invisible electromagnetic waves circulate all around you. Here. There. Everywhere. This receiver picks up dangerous electromagnetic waves from outer space. Strange... My parts are syncopating to the rhythms! Doo-da-doo-da-doo!

treasures.name: Spirit Sword
treasures.description: This sword is known for bestowing on its owner the power to make allies of forest spirits. Clearly it was given this odd green hue in anticipation of forest combat. The color does seem rather bright for any forest we know of. But maybe forests here are very...vibrant?

treasures.name: Sud Generator
treasures.description: Rubsy, dubsy, sudsy, blooooo! Rubsy, dubsy, sudsy, woooooo! Sudsy, sudsy, scrubadooooooo! The more you rub it, the more it bubbles and foams. Don't worry about its purpose... Just scrub!

treasures.name: Universally Best Art
treasures.description: Machines like me may not comprehend this, but people do. That is the essence of art, the soul of the craft. If you understand the goodness of this design, your senses are at the rank of a space pilot!

treasures.name: Analog Computer
treasures.description: This computer conveys the kind of vague data that falls outside the range of ones and zeros. Actually, to be honest, it's a little bit too vague, so it isn't very helpful.

treasures.name: Anti-Dioxin Filter
treasures.description: This fits over the rocket's exhaust port and filters out all disease-causing agents from the ship's exhaust. That means I'll be able to move around without polluting the planet's atmosphere!

treasures.name: Automatic Gear
treasures.description: This thing chugs right along at its own pace. It makes piloting much easier, giving me time to concentrate on the finer points of space travel.

treasures.name: Bowsprit
treasures.description: With this piece installed, my ship should regain some of its sleek shape. The so-called face of the Dolphin. In point of fact, I designed it.

treasures.name: Chronos Reactor
treasures.description: This reactor changes permutations in the space-time continuum into pure energy... Basically, it's like a big rubber band.

treasures.name: Eternal Fuel Dynamo
treasures.description: It has an unlimited energy supply! I won't have to worry about saving electricity anymore! This will make my fight for survival a bit easier...

treasures.name: Extraordinary Bolt
treasures.description: I bought this incredible bolt because the salesman told me it is of extraordinary quality that is indiscernible to the average person. Exactly what makes it so extraordinary is a secret. But just look at it! Extraordinary!

treasures.name: Geiger Counter
treasures.description: Every spaceship needs one of these, but I don't actually know what it's for. Every once in a while, it goes wild and lets out a lot of noise, but I never pay much attention to it, so it doesn't do me much good.

treasures.name: Gluon Drive
treasures.description: Using the quark-binding metaphysical properties of gluons, this device... Well, it's...very scientific, and I don't fully understand it myself, but it was very expensive...

treasures.name: Gravity Jumper
treasures.description: This anti-gravity device allows the Dolphin to swim gracefully through the sea of stars like...a dolphin.

treasures.name: Guard Satellite
treasures.description: Deep space is filled with dangers. This automated satellite does its part to help guard both me and my spaceship. I'll sleep better at night once this little satellite is back on duty.

treasures.name: Interstellar Radio
treasures.description: Not only does it emit a constant S.O.S. signal, it also broadcasts voices from space that will brighten up my moments of boredom. The Dolphin, while comfortable, becomes quite a lonely place in the depths of the night...

treasures.name: Ionium Jet
treasures.description: The ads for these jets boast that "with excellent mileage that's easy on the family budget, this jet will keep your wife smiling and propel you to a happy home life!"

treasures.name: Libra
treasures.description: My daughter gave this to me. It's named after her astrological sign. My sweet little girl... I wonder what she's doing right at this moment...

treasures.name: Main Engine
treasures.description: Amazing! There's no mistaking it! My ship's engine rests before my very eyes! By a stroke of pure luck, I have already stumbled upon the most important piece of my damaged craft! Fate has smiled upon me! But... How will I get it back to the Dolphin?

treasures.name: Massage Machine
treasures.description: Put this right down in the lower back area and let it go to work. I can't wait until I get this installed again, as my lower lumbar region has been paining me ever since the crash. Ahh, sweet relief...

treasures.name: Nova Blaster
treasures.description: This emits a dazzling burst of light capable of destroying almost anything! I'm not exactly sure about this, but the promotional brochure claims that its blasts can travel in the currents of space-time, smashing through stars and into the rifts of space.

treasures.name: Omega Stabilizer
treasures.description: I absolutely must have this piece if my battered ship is ever to fly straight again. It has steered me trough countless deep space storms. That, and it looks rather cool.

treasures.name: Pilot's Seat
treasures.description: Once I get this installed, my cockpit will finally be back in order. Soon, my ship will be starting to look more and more like the Dolphin of old. Ah, the memories...

treasures.name: Positron Generator
treasures.description: By combining its batteries with solar cells, this machine can generate incredible amounts of electricity. What a timely find! Those Instant Space Noodles will taste better when heated up.

treasures.name: Radiation Canopy
treasures.description: This turns the harsh radiation of deep space into soft, infrared rays that are easy on the body. I'll sleep like a baby once I get this back to the ship!

treasures.name: Repair-type Bolt
treasures.description: This robotic marvel can fix just about anything in the ship that's broken. That's good, because I get terribly bored fixing little glitches.

treasures.name: Sagittarius
treasures.description: My son gave this to me as a present. It brings to mind vision of my son back home on Planet Hocotate. Oh, to be back there right now!

treasures.name: Secret Safe
treasures.description: At last I have found it-my most prized possession! I am so relieved... It's as heavy as ever!

treasures.name: Shock Absorber
treasures.description: This apparatus counteracts the shaking and swaying that normally occurs during flight. It's smooth sailing with this in place... Usually.

treasures.name: Space Float
treasures.description: This float is an absolute necessity for any pilot who lacks skill at swimming in space.

treasures.name: UV Lamp
treasures.description: The only problem with this handheld light is that it can be too bright at times. I have to remember to wear my sun visor whenever I look into it.

treasures.name: Whimsical Radar
treasures.description: With this, I'll be able to see all nearby ship parts in a single glance-I just press Y to check it. This find fills me with great hope.

treasures.name: Zirconium Rotor
treasures.description: This is made from rust-proof zirconium, which is particularly suited to making spaceship parts. I had to pay a lot extra to have this installed, and I suspect the mechanic overcharged me.

treasures.name: Astringent Clump
treasures.description: It takes a refined palate to appreciate all this fruit has to offer. It is at once sweet, sour, bitter, and even spicy. But those capable of pushing through the complex, slightly painful taste experience will find themselves greatly rewarded.

treasures.name: Blonde Impostor
treasures.description: Is the Blonde Impostor simply a Disguised Delicacy in...disguise?" you might ask. Not at all! It's very much its own fruit! It's juicy and sweet, and it has even more of the beautifying vitamin, Piktamin U, than its green cousin. Imposter? Psh. It's as real as it gets!

treasures.name: Citrus Lump
treasures.description: The thick, acidic rind of this item is proof positive of its highly elevated mental functions. When I assess it, I am somehow reminded of a particularly hateful superior. Hurry up and devour it!

treasures.name: Combustion Berry
treasures.description: Everything is best in moderation. This fruit is the perfect example of too much of a good thing. Its devastating sweetness is like an act of violence on the palate, scouring all with succulence...

treasures.name: Crimson Banquet
treasures.description: This thing is enormous... It's the size of an asteroid, with hard, striped skin. It's not very inviting. So what a surprise it was to find that its insides are bursting with crimson juice. And seeds too! Plant these in the garden, and maybe more tasty asteroids will grow.

treasures.name: Crunchy Deluge
treasures.description: The amount of moisture contained inside this fruit is quite shocking! Underestimate it, and you might bite down only to find yourself awash in a sea of juice! Be sure to have a snorkel at the ready when eating one of these.

treasures.name: Crush Nugget
treasures.description: If a crush was a taste rather than a feeling, this fruit is where you'd go to experience it. The feeling starts small when you take that first bite and think, "Humph...I'm not so sure I like it." But then you take another bite...and another...only to discover that you not only like the taste but have come to love it. Suddenly you have a full-blown food crush on your hands! Just remember-many things in life are an acquired taste. So be sure to keep an open mind.

treasures.name: Cupid's Grenade
treasures.description: A fruit both powerful and delicate! It reminds me of something I once read... "Fate's tapestry has unraveled. Tomorrow weeps. Romance has fallen; love is madness. To mend the rift between two cross lovers, this is the ultimate weapon in Cupid's arsenal."

treasures.name: Dapper Blob
treasures.description: It looks for all the world like this fruit is wearing a jaunty hat! Ah, but the Dapper Blob's attire is beside the point. It's the juicy flesh inside... deeply sweet yet delightfully bitter too...that's the real star of the show here! A fruit fit for royalty!

treasures.name: Dawn Pustules
treasures.description: It's difficult to say which aspect of this fruit is more charming-its pretty emerald color or how easy it is to share with friends. Thankfully, you don't have to choose. Simply gaze upon the gorgeous green hue as you share its many orbs at a party.

treasures.name: Delectable Bouquet
treasures.description: Eat this fruit before it's ripe, and you'll never do it a second time. Yuck and blech! But you mustn't get angry. No, let this be a lesson in patience. For you see, those with the discipline to wait until the perfect time to eat the Delectable Bouquet...they will be greatly rewarded!

treasures.name: Disguised Delicacy
treasures.description: It's a miracle anyone tried to eat this unpleasant-looking fruit the very first time. You'd think its hairy exterior would have scared them off. Yet eat it they did! And we should all be grateful, for what a tasty treat it is! Further proof that luck favors the bold.

treasures.name: Dusk Pustules
treasures.description: Stare at the deep, dark orbs of this fruit, and you might fall into a hypnotic trance. But not to worry. The minute you take a bite, you'll be snapped from your reverie by a powerful blast of sweet juice. What a journey it takes you on. You may never want to return!

treasures.name: Face Wrinkler
treasures.description: The heart-squeezing excitement one feels upon falling in love the first time is not so different from the jaw- clenching salivation that occurs when one takes their first taste of this fruit. I daresay both experiences are thrilling...if just a touch painful.

treasures.name: Fire-Breathing Feast
treasures.description: Despite its wild and intimidating outer appearance, this fruit looks quite fancy and refined on the inside. Tiny black specks decorate bright white flesh. All in all, it looks like an egg from the nest of some fire-breathing half-animal, half-plant beast!

treasures.name: Heroine's Tear
treasures.description: When you lay eyes upon the elegant tear shape of this fruit, it may just bring a tear to your own eye. The perfection of it makes everything else in life seem somehow less...perfect. Then, when you taste how perfectly sweet it is...prepare to weep with joy.

treasures.name: Insect Condo
treasures.description: This fruit is a member of the plant family "Bugeatenidae." As its name implies, the Insect Condo is a popular abode choice for a number of insects. And who can blame the bugs for taking up residence here? This fruit is not just homey but also quite delicious.

treasures.name: Juicy Gaggle
treasures.description: What a charming fruit this is! If it had a personality, I'd say it was "cute and bubbly." Such a vibrant and passionate color too. There's just so much to love here. But like love itself, this fruit is delicate, so treat it with care!

treasures.name: Lesser Mock Bottom
treasures.description: It's true-the rounded surface of this fruit is smooth as a baby's bottom. Meanwhile, the pale yellow flesh inside offers a refreshing flavor profile that is at once sweet and also sour. Really, as fruits go, it has much to offer.

treasures.name: Love Nugget
treasures.description: I don't know what it is about this fruit...vegetable...whatever it is...but take one bite, and your heart is sure to heat up. I know mine does. Is it love at first bite? Or am I just imagining things?

treasures.name: Mock Bottom
treasures.description: What's most impressive about this fruit is the way it's sweet in both flavor and aroma. Meanwhile, its pretty pinkish-orange coloring is lovely to behold. Of course, one can't ignore the shapely curves reminiscent of... eh... Good manners dictate I say no more. Suffice it to say, the Mock Bottom is quite a sensory experience.

treasures.name: Pocked Airhead
treasures.description: Children love this fruit for its adorable shape. See how it looks for all the world like a jolly orange snowman? But the Pocked Airhead is more than just a cute character. Its taste is sweet, and its strange, lumpy skin is easy to peel. There's much to love about this citrus snowman!

treasures.name: Portable Sunset
treasures.description: This fruit gets its color by soaking up the rays of each sunset. And though it's quite bitter during its youth, it grows increasingly sweet with age until it's close to perfect as it falls off the branch. Let this remind us all to look forward to our sunset years!

treasures.name: Scaly Custard
treasures.description: It's a food...and yet it resembles some kind of scaly beast? Let's agree that the initial impression is not a good one! And yet...inside awaits a rich, creamy culinary delight! Oh, you Scaly Custard, you. Many have judged you harshly, and for that, I'm truly sorry.

treasures.name: Searing Acidshock
treasures.description: Try eating this fruit when it's green and unripe, and you'll end up with a mouth full of acidic burning. But give it time to ripen, and it will not only taste sweet on the tongue but restore your energy and give you the endurance to realize great ambitions!

treasures.name: Seed Hive
treasures.description: There's no other way to say it... The inside of the Seed Hive is quite grotesque. That knot of black orbs in its belly... YUCK! But many seeds means many cultivation opportunities. And there's no reason to turn our noses up at that.

treasures.name: Slapstick Crescent
treasures.description: Clearly this fruit was designed to be sent on outings with children. Note the built-in wrapper that's easy to remove. But children mustn't toss the wrapper on the ground. Someone is sure to slip on it and land on their behind! Hilarious? Maybe. Painful? Definitely.

treasures.name: Stellar Extrusion
treasures.description: Is this a fruit or a shooting star that's fallen to the ground? One taste, and the answer is yours! Better yet, cut this star into slices, and enjoy yourself a fruity constellation. How heavenly!

treasures.name: Sunseed Berry
treasures.description: No matter how down you may be, these tasty bursts of joy are almost sure to turn your mood around. That's because they're happiness in fruit form! As the name implies, they plant seeds of sunny warmth in the middle of your heart, and there they grow, like an invasive species of happiness.

treasures.name: Tremendous Sniffer
treasures.description: The flavor here is mellow and sweet, while the aroma is pure elegance. And speaking of aroma...please observe the shape. Does this fruit not resemble a nose? It's quite uncanny, I say! One wonders if it can smell its own deliciously aromatic self?

treasures.name: Velvety Dreamdrop
treasures.description: This fruit is a treat for the senses. Not only is its bright, tear-shaped form pretty to look at, its soft surface is also slightly velvety to the touch. Yes, two senses delighted by one fruit! Or, as they say, "Two birds, one stone!" Oh dear! Speaking of stones...do NOT eat the seeds. They're quite poisonous!

treasures.name: Wayward Moon
treasures.description: From its artistic, cratered exterior to its delicately sweet interior, the Wayward Moon is elegance in fruit form. Mild and aromatic, it would make a wonderful gift for a friend or for someone who just needs a little pick-me-up.

treasures.name: Zest Bomb
treasures.description: A number of fruits look quite similar to this one. But while it may be rather forgettable in appearance, its refreshing fragrance will live in your memory forever. Those with a mature palate should also sample its bitter taste. A zesty experience indeed!

treasures.name: Bug Bait
treasures.description: I have a bad feeling about this particular item... I want to sell it with all possible speed... Bzzrpt! Bargain price available. Please! Buy this quickly! NOW!

treasures.name: Chocolate Cushion
treasures.description: A sweet-tooth's dream! Is this real? Or am I dreaming? If I had teeth, I'd be nibbling with vigor!

treasures.name: Comfort Cookie
treasures.description: With this, your legs will not fall asleep even when you sit with your feet tucked beneath you. The sugary material of this cushion infuses your whole body with warmth and comfort.

treasures.name: Compelling Cookie
treasures.description: Is your palate conservative or adventuresome? Either way, this taste will ravish your mouth. For those who savor flavor, this new delicacy will have you questioning your ideas of taste.

treasures.name: Confection Hoop
treasures.description: This sugary delight has even a machine like me wishing to partake in its deliciousness! What a sweet-looking circlet!

treasures.name: Cookie of Nibbled Circles
treasures.description: Someone went to great lengths to first nibble this cookie into a perfect circle and then to nibble a perfect circle out of the middle of the cookie. The cookie craftsmanship exhibited here...it's mind-boggling, really.

treasures.name: Cookie of Prosperity
treasures.description: It's said the two colors in this cookie bring good luck to one's family and to one's business. In fact, it was a tradition here for families to gather around a cookie and eat it together. There's even a saying about it: "The family that eats a cookie together gets rich together."

treasures.name: Cushion Cake
treasures.description: Did you know this lumpy cake doubles as a cushion? What a clever idea, no? It's just the right amount of softness and firmness for sitting on. And when you grow hungry, you just take a bite. What a sweet treat it is too! Who knew a cushion could be so satisfying?

treasures.name: Deceptive Snack
treasures.description: This treasure takes a sophisticated palate to appreciate. First, a salty- sweet sauce is put atop some kind of white foodstuff. It's then fried and topped with a thin black layer of... paper? It sounds awful, but it tastes wonderful. Surprising in the best way!

treasures.name: Diet Doomer
treasures.description: Alas, we machines know nothing of eating! The ultimate pleasure... If only I had a mouth!

treasures.name: Enamel Buster
treasures.description: Behold, a magical candy to make the children of Hocotate weep with uncontrollable cravings. Pure, undeniable sweetness; unavoidable tooth decay. Who cares? Enjoy the here and now!

treasures.name: Flaky Temptation
treasures.description: Flaky layer upon flaky layer of buttery, mouth-melting dough baked to golden perfection... Indeed, this is temptation in bread form. You will try to eat a "reasonable" amount. But some strange force has hold of your taste buds, and thus "reasonable" has no meaning. Devastatingly delicious!

treasures.name: Hearty Container
treasures.description: The shape of this treasure represents perhaps the most important things there are in the universe. Life and love. If you pour your heart into this cookie and give it to someone you care about, it's sure to have a powerful effect on them.

treasures.name: Impenetrable Cookie
treasures.description: It is hard. Really hard. Too hard. So hard that you're not sure you can eat it, even though you must. This hard snack is infused with the essence of stubbornness, and you are powerless to resist it.

treasures.name: Imperative Cookie
treasures.description: One look at this pattern and your head spins, your vision fades, and a voice commands: "Eat this!"

treasures.name: Jiggle-Jiggle
treasures.description: Even a slight touch will make this treasure jiggle and wiggle in the most wonderful way. Yet for all the seismic stresses, it never collapses! Still, what's even more entrancing than the Jiggle-Jiggle's wiggle is its taste. The sweetness will make YOU tremble!

treasures.name: King of Sweets
treasures.description: Humanoid desire knows no limits. Some things can never be known or understood. And no researcher, no matter how supreme, will ever tire of consuming this thing. It contains a mystic flavor born of the cosmos itself, and is said to change flavor as it is eaten.

treasures.name: Love's Fortune Cookie
treasures.description: Do they love me? Do they love me not? These are the questions we have all asked ourselves at one time or another. And this cookie has the answer. Simply eat each tasty petal as you ask your question. What will the answer be? The final bite will tell!

treasures.name: Pale Passion
treasures.description: This will save our loveless age! Yes, it is a romance-filled addition to the sweet tooth series! The sweet aroma will attract members of the opposite gender.

treasures.name: Pastry Wheel
treasures.description: This is perfect for the kiddies: a small, well-formed ring of sugar. Go on! Gulp it down!

treasures.name: Puzzle Snack
treasures.description: This snack not only satisfies hunger but intellectual curiosity too. How do the arms of this snack intertwine like that? Get some friends together, and talk it over while you nibble away on the problem itself. You're sure to arrive at the tasty answer eventually!

treasures.name: S.S. Berry
treasures.description: This spaceship was clearly styled to look like a cake with fruit atop it. I suspect it was specially designed for couples heading to space on their honeymoon. Goodness, I hope no one tries to eat it. The ship might crash in some strange locale! Hardly the idyllic vacation newlyweds dream of.

treasures.name: S.S. Chocolate
treasures.description: It was this adorable ship's yummy smell that lured me in. Then, suddenly, I was taking a bite. Lo and behold, I found the ship to be...edible! In fact, it's chocolate flavored! I'm still not quite sure what to make of this discovery. All I know is...it's a DELICIOUS one.

treasures.name: S.S. Peppermint
treasures.description: What a refreshing aroma! And what charming decorations! And that gorgeous color too! Popular with the young crowd, this spaceship wakes you up as it whisks you away on a minty-fresh journey to another planet. Just don't take a bite out of it, or you'll never make it back.

treasures.name: Sticky Jewel
treasures.description: Not only is this glimmering gem quite beautiful but the mineral it's composed of is notable for being highly sticky. Often given as a present to a loved one, it represents a bond that is equally adhesive.

treasures.name: Succulent Mattress
treasures.description: Sweet to the taste and touch! Sleep on this magical mattress and dream of a land of sweets.

treasures.name: Sweet Dreamer
treasures.description: A comfy, not-too-sugary bed. Youngsters who sleep here will have the sweetest of dreams.

treasures.name: Sweet Stumble-Not
treasures.description: What a sweet stick this is! Quite literally, this stick here is made of candy from top to bottom. This unexpected combination makes it quite the handy thing to have around. You can use it as a walking stick to prevent yourself from stumbling while hiking or exploring unfamiliar terrain. When all that exertion makes you hungry, you'll find sustenance right there in your hand. A useful invention, to be sure!

treasures.name: Sweet Torrent
treasures.description: Be warned-if you take a bite of this doughy raft, you'll quickly find yourself awash in a torrential river of sweet cream. Your only choice is to eat, eat, eat as quickly as you can. If you can't keep up, ask someone to throw you a life preserver before it's too late!

treasures.name: Triple Sugar Threat
treasures.description: This will satisfy any sweet tooth! It begins with savory softness, then fills the mouth with fluffs of flavor, and finally overwhelms with a river of sweetness. It is a three-pronged tongue assault!

treasures.name: Vanishing Cookie
treasures.description: Is it possible for a cookie to be TOO delicious? It seems it is. This very cookie is so incredibly tasty that it vanishes almost as soon as it appears. Where it goes...nobody knows. But if you ever want to taste it, you'll have to move fast!

treasures.name: White Goodness
treasures.description: No dreams? Take love. No love? Take sweets! This is the most potent item in the sweet tooth series.

treasures.name: Devil's Portrait
treasures.effect: Count as part of any one set
treasures.description: What an unsettling portrait! Just look at that devilish face, not to mention that clown-like getup...and that odd grin! What IS he up to? No good, I say! No, there's nothing more unnerving than when someone smiles at you... and you aren't sure why.

treasures.name: Dream Material
treasures.effect: Destroy a hazard on your opponent's side of the board
treasures.description: This nonconductive substance has many uses: I have discovered it can even erase pencil marks. It is a dream material! But the more it is used, the more it crumbles. The same is true of dreams.

treasures.name: Mega Horn
treasures.effect: Discard a Boss on the board
treasures.description: Bounce on the squishy bulb end to produce an earth-shattering roar the likes of which you've never heard! Large brass instruments such as this added volume to band performances. Just don't stand in front of the horn end if you like your eardrums.

treasures.name: Time Marker
treasures.effect: Discard a Boss on the board
treasures.description: This great bell has traditionally been rung at the end of each day, each month, and each year. And what a beautiful tone to mark the passage of time! Of course, once one counts up how many times they've rung this bell, that pretty jingle may turn into quite the startling jangle. How is it that so much time has flown by?!

treasures.name: Personal-Injury Plank
treasures.effect: Discard all enemies in one lane
treasures.description: To use this mode of transportation, you must stand on the trolley and kick the ground to propel yourself forward. You can also sit on the trolley and push yourself along with your hands. It's more thrilling than riding a typical trolley...but also a lot more work.

treasures.name: King of Bugs
treasures.description: A new employee of Hocotate Freight, Louie is often silent. Nobody knows what thoughts lurk in his mind. He appears to operate on the same wavelength as insects, often with dangerous results. After he was kidnapped, he somehow managed to hijack a colossal insect's brain!

treasures.name: Wind Detector
treasures.effect: Discard an Enemy on the board
treasures.description: Ah, what striking tones do play as the wind dances through this silvery treasure! The musical notes that flow from the holes announce the arrival of a breeze, and in doing so they weave a song both sweet and melancholy. It's a sentimental soundtrack... One best suited for a fall afternoon spent contemplating the passing of the seasons.

treasures.name: Luck Wafer
treasures.effect: Draw a random card from your opponent's hand.
treasures.description: This appears when you have no money to play the lottery, and floats away when you do. The mystic pattern is a magnet for good luck, so at least you can enjoy feeling lucky!

treasures.name: Wisdom Emblem
treasures.effect: Draw a random card from your opponent's hand.
treasures.description: I feel certain the shape seen here represents wisdom. Just look at its arching symmetry! It is elegant but not ostentatious. Complex but not overly ornate. It brings to mind scholars with noses in books and scientists working toward conclusions.

treasures.name: Work Emblem
treasures.effect: Draw a random card from your opponent's hand.
treasures.description: I don't know what it is about these symbols that puts me at ease, but they do. Might be a good idea to hang this sheet up at the workplace when the stress starts kicking in. Of course, without stress...how will I get my work done? Quite the conundrum, no?

treasures.name: Mechanical Harp (Lullabies)
treasures.description: The song played on this device is intended to make the listener feel sleepy and yet terrified to fall asleep at the same time. How odd that a piece of music can make you feel like you're staring down a mouth full of razor-sharp teeth.

treasures.name: Disk of Sorrowful Wisdom
treasures.effect: Flip a coin: If heads, draw 2 pellet cards
treasures.description: In moments of sorrow, it may be helpful to consult with this unusually intelligent life-form. Empathy is one of the highest forms of intelligence, so this disk surely has more than enough to share with you. You may not be able to hear its wisdom, but you will feel it.

treasures.name: Disk of Angry Wisdom
treasures.effect: Flip a coin: If heads, draw a gather card
treasures.description: Better keep an eye out when in close proximity to this sentient disk. Apparently it has a bit of an anger-management problem. Further details about its tendency to lash out have been lost to time-which makes it all the more intimidating, doesn't it?

treasures.name: Disk of Surprising Wisdom
treasures.effect: Flip a coin: If heads, draw a treasure card
treasures.description: Should you ever find yourself stunned beyond words, this wise creature will be a true friend to you. Let its waves of knowledge wash over you and bring about a deep inner calm. Indeed, there's something soothing about simply being in its presence.

treasures.name: Double Dragon-Eyed Scope
treasures.description: This massive scope allows two viewers to stand side by side and see far into the distance. As if that wasn't impressive enough, it looks as if its design was based on dragon eyes. It's just the thing for a couple of adventurous explorers who hate taking turns!

treasures.name: Stupendous Lens
treasures.description: Peek into this item with a sense of wonder and glimpse a frighteninly gigantic world. This lens is a window into the thrilling world of tiny creatures everywhere!

treasures.name: Internal-Clock Measurer
treasures.effect: Move the day track back one space
treasures.description: This timepiece doesn't measure the passage of time in general but the passage of time as felt by the one holding it. The user presses the top button once per second. But how fast or slow they press it depends on what a second feels like to them. Profound!

treasures.name: Solar-Powered Computing Machine
treasures.effect: Move the day track back one space
treasures.description: This enormous computing machine not only allows for complex number crunching but ensures these critical calculations can be completed whenever needed. Note the enormous solar cell that powers it. Whoever built this marvel has harnessed the incandescent fury of the sun itself...and used it for math!

treasures.name: Geographic Projection
treasures.effect: Respawn all enemies on your side of the board
treasures.description: If you have both pieces, does the value increase? Do you want it? Need it? Crave it? You should. This is the ultimate storehouse of geographic data in the known universe.

treasures.name: Gift of Friendship
treasures.effect: Search the Gather Deck for an Oatchi Rush card
treasures.description: Dogs have been our dear and most faithful companions since the dawn of civilization. This necklace represents that ancient and honorable bond, both physically and spiritually. A well-worn necklace such as this is the mark of a friendship like no other.

treasures.name: Flame of Tomorrow
treasures.effect: Treasures worth less than 100p are worth 100 more
treasures.description: Is this the flame of hope that spawned humanoid civilization? Hocotate needs new energy sources, and this could be a fine candidate. Will machines like me be powered by this someday?

treasures.name: Fleeting Art Form
treasures.effect: Treasures worth less than 100p are worth 100 more
treasures.description: On the surface, this is not art! It is a temporary spectacle compared to the glory of eternity. And yet that is WHY it is art! Machines like me are incapable of comprehending this...

treasures.name: Prototype Detector
treasures.effect: Your opponent draws a free treasure from the deck
treasures.description: Is this a miracle gadget born of universal desire, or a machine manufactured by the master of Dimension X? Whatever it is, it reacts to treasure!

treasures.name: Shock Therapist
treasures.effect: Your opponent places 2 Electricity Generators on your side
treasures.description: This nanotech device gathers negative ions in the atmosphere and converts them into energy. It then releases that energy. Zap! Use it to relieve muscle soreness and joint stress. One warning, however: it does render the user unconscious.

treasures.name: Flare Cannon
treasures.effect: Your opponent places 2 Fire Geysers on your side of the board
treasures.description: In the compressed-air cylinder of this flamethrower, liquid gas is lit, producing the fire that gives the weapon its name. It is very dangerous, and good kids know not to play with it. In case you wonder, it cannot be used as a substitute for a spaceship's rockets and should never be used to cook sausages. Never.

treasures.name: Deity's Portrait
treasures.effect: Count as part of any one set
treasures.description: This portrait shows a half-man, half-fish deity worshipped by ancient sailors. He was known for being both kind and cruel. One minute he'd test the sailors by sending bad weather their way-the next he'd save them with a blast of air from his horn to their sails.

treasures.name: Danger Chime
treasures.effect: Discard a Boss on the board
treasures.description: No danger, no matter how small, dodges the notice of this never-fail, peace-of-mind alarm system. In fact, it will warn you of danger that is not even present!

treasures.name: Soul Reverberator
treasures.effect: Discard a Boss on the board
treasures.description: The implications of this technology are quite frightening. Not only does it broadcast music played by a musician but pieces of the musician's own soul. We always knew they put their hearts and souls into their songs. But this takes it to a whole new level!

treasures.name: Path Creator
treasures.effect: Discard all enemies in one lane
treasures.description: This warning device, worn by ancient guardian deities, would be rung loudly for all to hear when a villager committed a wrongdoing. Anyone who heard it would then immediately fall to the ground, clearing the way for the guardians to pass.

treasures.name: Justice Alloy
treasures.effect: Discard all enemies on your opponent's side of the board
treasures.description: You cannot see it and you cannot touch it, but it is definitely here and there. What, you ask? Whatever this suit is fortified by , that is what. I cannot believe there is a better material than what I am constructed of...

treasures.name: Professional Noisemaker
treasures.description: Noisier than a spaceship, this wonderful item will make your miserable life 120 percent more exciting.

treasures.name: Emperor Whistle
treasures.effect: Discard an Enemy on the board
treasures.description: Healing tones are old news? Well, greet the new trend: super sounds of awakening! Air passing through the inner chamber sounds a high note that acts as an acoustic refreshment.

treasures.name: Doomsday Aparatus
treasures.effect: Does not move unless a purple is on this space
treasures.description: An apocalyptic weapon made of super-heavy, gravity-compressed materials of unknown origin. The fact that its great weight makes it uncontrollable is, at times, a mild detriment.

treasures.name: Courage Emblem
treasures.effect: Draw a random card from your opponent's hand.
treasures.description: This symbol looks like a container of some sort...perhaps one that contains life itself. I get a sense of vitality from it...almost as if the more of these you have, the more power you have to overcome adversity. But be careful. I'm sure they're not easy to obtain.

treasures.name: Love Emblem
treasures.effect: Draw a random card from your opponent's hand.
treasures.description: Looking at these symbols all lined up... I feel my heartbeat quicken, and yes, I feel this rush of warmth that must be...love. This kind of love says, "Cherish all things. Love yourself-love your enemies-love everything!" It's a tall order, but I will try!

treasures.name: Money Emblem
treasures.effect: Draw a random card from your opponent's hand.
treasures.description: My mind wanders to dark places when I look at these symbols. All I see are gemstones-and ill-gotten gemstones, at that. Perhaps they're stolen jewels, confiscated by police and laid out like this as evidence. The stink of crime is in the air!

treasures.name: Power Emblem
treasures.effect: Draw a random card from your opponent's hand.
treasures.description: There can be no doubt that the symbol seen here represents power. Look at it. Everything about it screams "strength"! Surely in the right (and even wrong) hands, its power would be immense. Perhaps it's best not to approach it unless you have to.

treasures.name: Mechanical Harp (Memory Song)
treasures.description: This device plays a beautiful melody that elicits feelings of nostalgia. There's something so familiar about it, and yet at the same time, it's completely unknown. Mysterious, to be sure!

treasures.name: Mechanical Harp (Windmills)
treasures.description: To feel the excitement of a grand adventure, all you need to do is play this device! It seems to sing of heroic tales and captured princesses... I hope one day I'm able to sell these rare treasures to a hero as valiant as these dulcet tones.

treasures.name: Disk of Amusing Wisdom
treasures.effect: Flip a coin: If heads, draw 2 gather cards
treasures.description: Sometimes you wake up and decide that today will be unlike every other standard-issue day. "Today," you tell yourself, "will be filled with fun and amusement!" And what could be more amusing than dancing? Why, nothing! On days like this, simply grab this disk and get your groove on. Swing it round with abandon! Yes, soon enough, you will have to return to life as usual. But I promise it's OK to let your inner rhythm take you away on occasion.

treasures.name: Disk of Joyous Wisdom
treasures.effect: Flip a coin: If heads, draw a pellet card
treasures.description: Do not be fooled by its silence! You are in the presence of the most intelligent life-form in the known universe. Based on its appearance, it's clear this creature can exude feelings of joy and delight. It was likely at the center of many social gatherings long ago.

treasures.name: Detective's Truth Seeker
treasures.description: Surely this powerful viewing device was used by a brilliant professor trying to catch a glimpse of the truth hiding in the most fundamental level of the universe. But when they looked through here, did they find that truth? And did the truth look bigger and a bit out of focus?

treasures.name: Number Jumper
treasures.effect: Move the day track back one space
treasures.description: This clever exercise machine combines the joys of doing math with the thrill of physical exertion. When performing complex math tasks, simply jump from key to key to key. I daresay finding solutions to math problems has never been so fun!

treasures.name: Temporal Mechanism
treasures.effect: Move the day track back one space
treasures.description: This piece of technology doesn't work, so there's no way to confirm it...but I believe in my heart of hearts that it is part of a time machine. A foolish belief, maybe. But I have faith that the future holds many great things, and this is simply a sign of what's to come!

treasures.name: Spherical Atlas
treasures.effect: Respawn all enemies on your side of the board
treasures.description: The surface designs on this item are the map of a savage planet. This alone makes it valuable... But that is not all! Embedded within is a microchip filled with secret, incredibly detailed data. With this item, you'll know everything about this, that, and the other thing, too.

treasures.name: Lamp of Inspiration
treasures.effect: Treasures worth less than 100p are worth 100 more
treasures.description: This lamp is the very definition of inspiring. With the figure of a proud woman holding a torch on high, it not only lights up a room with its glow but lights up the spirits of those who gaze upon it.

treasures.name: Olfactory Sculpture
treasures.effect: Treasures worth less than 100p are worth 100 more
treasures.description: You can't see the artistry at work here with your eyes, but take a deep breath, and your nose will behold the power and beauty at once. One whiff, and your heart will light up! Surely this gorgeous olfactory sculpture belongs in an art gallery!

treasures.name: Stellar Orb
treasures.effect: Your opponent chooses the order of one treasure pile on the board
treasures.description: This tanning machine is based on primitive science principles. Come, you pallid recluses and sun-starved hermits! You, too, can have a healthy, stylish glow!

treasures.name: Comedy Bomb
treasures.effect: Your opponent places 2 Poison Emitters on your side of the board
treasures.description: You cannot see it. You cannot smell it. Yet this weapon would steal your life, given the chance. At least it USED to, until I shrewdly exchanged its poison gas for hilarious laughing gas. Crafted with an eye for safety, it is the funniest weapon ever devised!

treasures.name: Monster Pump
treasures.effect: Your opponent places 2 Water Spouts on your side of the board
treasures.description: This item automatically detects subterranean waterways, even if the water is buried a mile deep! This monster pump draws liquid any distance, and its almost-uncontrollable power is fantastic!
